  114: node_enrollment_remote_custodian(Config) ->
  115:     Source = ?config(asker, Config), Custodian = ?config(target, Config),
  116:     SourceKey = ?config(asker_pub, Config), HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  117:     SourceAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT}, HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config),
  118:     NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  119:     NodeSource = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/quod_node.pl"),
  120:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "enrollment-class"),
  121:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
  122:         [NodeNs, #{node_id => SourceKey, mode => create, data_dir => NodeDir,
  123:                    seed_peers => [], genesis_file => NodeSource,
  124:                    external_predicate_modules => [quod_ontology_predicates]}]),
  125:     ok = peer:call(Source, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready, [NodeNs, {isa, node, {':',quod,{':',agent,agent}}}], 15000),
  126:     NodeAnchor = peer:call(Source, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [NodeNs]),
  127:     start_brahms(Source, NodeNs, SourceAddr, []),
  128:     {ok, Template} = file:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  129:                                                  "ontologies/node_instance.pl")),
  130:     HostNs = <<"node:remote-custodian">>,
  131:     Options = quod_ct:node_identity_options(HostNs, me, HostKey),
  132:     {ok, [#{'A' := HostAnchor}], _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  133:         [?ROOT_NS, {create_ontology, HostNs, Options, {'A'}}], 30000),
  134:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  135:         [HostNs, {instance_of, node, me}], 15000),
  136:     Host = {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me},
  137:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  138:         [HostNs, {assertz, {ontology_hosting_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  139:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, execute, [NodeNs, {transaction, {',',
  140:         {assertz, {node_identity_template, Template}},
  141:         {assertz, {node_identity_allocation, HostKey, Host, Host}}}}]),
  142:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  143:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creation_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  144:     ok = enrollment_route(Source, HostKey, HostAddr,
  145:         [{?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}, {HostNs, HostAnchor, validator}]),
  146:     ok = enrollment_route(Custodian, SourceKey, SourceAddr, [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  147:     {Public, _} = Pair = quod_identity:generate(),
  148:     {ok, Instance} = quod_client_goal_parser:format({enrolling, Public}),
  149:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(#{network_identity => ?config(network_id, Config),
  150:         signing_public_key => Public, operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  151:         agent_namespace => NodeNs, agent_genesis_anchor => NodeAnchor,
  152:         agent_instance_text => Instance, mode => execute, parser_version => 3,
  153:         not_after_ms => quod_time:now_ms() + 30000, goal_text => <<"enroll_node(Ref).">>}),
  154:     Sig = quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(Pair)),
  155:     Result = peer:call(Source, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000),
  156:     case Result of
  157:         {ok, _, {normalized, {failed, Reasons}}} ->
  158:             ct:fail({enrollment_failed, quod_wire_term:decode_failure_reasons(Reasons)});
  159:         _ -> ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
  160:     end,
  161:     {ok, [#{'Ref' := {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, me} = Ref}], _} =
  162:         peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  163:             [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, {'Ref'}, Host}]),
  164:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  165:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  166:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  167:         [Ns, {agent_key, me, Public, active}], 15000),
  168:     ?assertEqual({error, not_hosted},
  169:         peer:call(Source, quod_ontology, genesis_anchor, [Ns])),
  170:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  171:         [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, Ref, Host}])),
  172:     %% No publication or follow has primed this newly created identity yet.
  173:     Cost = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_local_evidence_cost,
  174:                   [{Ns, Anchor}, [{HostKey, [HostAddr]}]], 20000),
  175:     ct:pal("Unchanged current reads: ~p", [Cost]),
  176:     automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor, Host).
  177: 
  178: automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor,
  179:                       {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me} = Host) ->
  180:     Custodian = ?config(target, Config), Applicant = ?config(third, Config),
  181:     HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config), NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  182:     HostDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "custodian-identity"),
  183:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "applicant-identity"),
  184:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, HostDir]),
  185:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  186:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_node_actor, verify, [HostBlob, ?config(target_pub, Config)]),
  187:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, quod_identity, store_node_actor_pointer, [HostDir, HostBlob]),
  188:     {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [HostNs, HostCfg]}}} =
  189:         peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, get_childspec,
  190:             [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, HostNs}]),
  191:     HostDataDir = peer:call(Custodian, quod_ledger_store, ledger_dir, [HostCfg]),
  192:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env,
  193:         [quod, content_data_dir, HostDataDir]),
  194:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, content_data_dir, NodeDir]),
  195:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Dir, Contacts}) ->
  196:         {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [?ROOT_NS, RootCfg]}}} =
  197:             peer:call(Peer, supervisor, get_childspec,
  198:                 [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, ?ROOT_NS}]),
  199:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env,
  200:             [quod, namespace_static_content, #{?ROOT_NS => RootCfg}]),
  201:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child,
  202:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  203:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child,
  204:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  205:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, directory,
  206:             #{identity_dir => Dir, root_contacts => Contacts}]),
  207:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  208:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  209:         ok = peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, start_tracking, [])
  210:     end, [{Custodian, HostDir, []}, {Applicant, NodeDir, [HostAddr]}]),
  211:     ok = enrollment_route(Applicant, ?config(asker_pub, Config), {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  212:          [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  213:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  214:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {system_ontology, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  215:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, NodeDir]),
  216:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_complete, [], 60000),
  217:     {ok, Blob} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_identity, load_node_actor_pointer, [NodeDir]),
  218:     {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}, reference := Ref}} = quod_agent_ref:decode(Blob),
  219:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])),
  220:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS])),
  221:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  222:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  223:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  224:         [Ns, {hosts_ontology, Ref, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  225:     {ok, Bytes, Sig} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_node_actor, signed_goal,
  226:         [read, true, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000]),
  227:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}},
  228:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000)),
  229:     %% The custodian must validate an observer's publication even though its
  230:     %% own local member is the identity's sole current-tip answerer.
  231:     ApplicantAuthor = {node_actor, Blob},
  232:     {ok, First} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  233:                             [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, none], 20000),
  234:     %% No new resync request: renew on the existing authenticated stream and
  235:     %% observe the received generation, not a send trace.
  236:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  237:                         [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, First], 20000),
  238:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  239:     HostAuthor = {node_actor, HostBlob},
  240:     {ok, HostFirst} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  241:                               [HostAuthor, Host, none], 20000),
  242:     {ok, BeforeRestart} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  243:                         [HostAuthor, Host, HostFirst], 20000),
  244:     HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  245:     #{control_links := BeforeLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  246:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  247:     {_, OldLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, BeforeLinks),
  248:     %% The transport survives a directory-only restart. Its peer-opened
  249:     %% streams must reset so the new owner acquires fresh subscriptions.
  250:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, terminate_child,
  251:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  252:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, restart_child,
  253:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  254:     {ok, Recovered} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  255:         [HostAuthor, Host, BeforeRestart], 20000),
  256:     #{control_links := AfterLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  257:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  258:     {_, NewLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, AfterLinks),
  259:     ?assertNotEqual(OldLink, NewLink),
  260:     #{subscribers := Subscribers} = peer:call(Custodian,
  261:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  262:     %% The source peer may also subscribe to this root custodian. Require
  263:     %% exactly one stream per peer, including the restarted applicant link.
  264:     SubscriberKeys = [Key || {Key, _} <- maps:values(Subscribers)],
  265:     ApplicantKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  266:     ?assertEqual([ApplicantKey], [Key || Key <- SubscriberKeys, Key =:= ApplicantKey]),
  267:     ?assertEqual(lists:sort(SubscriberKeys), lists:usort(SubscriberKeys)),
  268:     ?assertMatch(#{control_link_count := 1},
  269:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_directory_control, stats, [])),
  270:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  271:         [HostAuthor, Host, Recovered], 20000).

  273: enrollment_local_evidence_cost(Identity, Sources) ->
  274:     Owner = quod_reg:where({foreign_log, node}),
  275:     Calls = [{quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence, 9},
  276:              {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity, 3},
  277:              {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, 1},
  278:              {quod_ledger_store, open, 3}, {quod_ledger_store, open_ro, 3},
  279:              {quod_ledger_store, fold, 5}, {quod_ledger_store, fold_groups, 3},
  280:              {quod_ledger_store, batch_sync, 1}, {file, datasync, 1}],
  281:     lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> 1 = erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, true, [local]) end, Calls),
  282:     1 = erlang:trace(Owner, true, [call, set_on_spawn, {tracer, self()}]),
  283:     try
  284:         {ok, A} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  285:         {ok, B} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  286:         ?assertEqual(maps:get(slot, A), maps:get(slot, B)),
  287:         Barrier = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
  288:         receive {trace_delivered, all, Barrier} -> ok after 5000 -> error(trace_timeout) end,
  289:         Events = enrollment_evidence_events([]),
  290:         {ok, SelfKey} = application:get_env(quod, node_pubkey),
  291:         Probes = lists:usort([Pid || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence,
  292:             [_, _, Peer, _, I | _]}} <- Events, Peer =:= SelfKey, I =:= Identity]),
  293:         ?assert(length(Probes) >= 1),
  294:         ?assertEqual(2, length([ok || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity,
  295:             [_, I, _]}} <- Events, Pid =:= Owner, I =:= Identity])),
  296:         Reads = [MFA || {Pid, MFA} <- Events, lists:member(Pid, Probes)],
  297:         ?assertEqual(length(Probes), length([ok || {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, _} <- Reads])),
  298:         ?assertEqual([], [MFA || {_, {M, F, _} = MFA} <- Events,
  299:             M =/= quod_foreign_log, {M, F} =/= {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot}]),
  300:         #{checks => 2, slot => maps:get(slot, B), local_probes => length(Probes),
  301:           archive_rebuilds_or_writes => 0}
  302:     after
  303:         erlang:trace(Owner, false, [call, set_on_spawn]),
  304:         lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, false, [local]) end, Calls)
  305:     end.
  306: 
  307: enrollment_evidence_events(Acc) ->
  308:     receive {trace, Pid, call, MFA} -> enrollment_evidence_events([{Pid, MFA} | Acc])
  309:     after 0 -> Acc end.
  310: 
  311: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After) ->
  312:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}),
  313:     try enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, quod_time:mono_ms() + 15000)
  314:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}) end.
  315: 
  316: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline) ->
  317:     case ets:lookup(quod_directory_highwater, Author) of
  318:         [{Author, Epoch, Number}] when {Epoch, Number} > After; After =:= none ->
  319:             {ok, {Epoch, Number}};
  320:         _ -> receive
  321:             {node_identity_route_changed, _, Ref} ->
  322:                 enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline)
  323:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  324:             error({generation_not_received, Author, After, quod_directory_control:stats()})
  325:         end
  326:     end.
  327: 
  328: enrollment_wait_complete() ->
  329:     Manager = quod_reg:where({namespace_manager, node}), Parent = self(),
  330:     Observer = fun(State, {in, {node_enrollment_result, _, Result}}, _) ->
  331:                        Parent ! {enrollment_progress, Result}, State;
  332:                   (State, _, _) -> State end,
  333:     ok = sys:install(Manager, {Observer, enrollment_test}),
  334:     try
  335:         ok = quod_namespace_manager:enroll_node(),
  336:         enrollment_wait_complete(quod_time:mono_ms() + 45000)
  337:     after sys:remove(Manager, Observer) end.
  338: 
  339: enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline) ->
  340:     case maps:get(node_enrollment, quod_namespace_manager:stats()) of
  341:         complete -> ok;
  342:         {error, Reason} -> error({enrollment_failed, Reason});
  343:         _ -> receive
  344:             {enrollment_progress, _} -> enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline)
  345:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  346:             error({enrollment_incomplete, quod_namespace_manager:stats()})
  347:         end
  348:     end.
  349: 
  350: %% These suite peers retain directory high-water marks across cases. Advance
  351: %% the synthetic author's epoch even when a preceding recovery case expired
  352: %% all its routes; never weaken the directory's stale-generation rejection.
  353: enrollment_route(Peer, Key, Endpoint, Hosted) ->
  354:     Author = {root_bootstrap, Key, Key},
  355:     Previous = peer:call(Peer, ets, lookup, [quod_directory_highwater, Author]),
  356:     Epoch = case Previous of [] -> 1; [{Author, E, _}] -> E + 1 end,
  357:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  358:                         [Key, Endpoint, Hosted, Epoch, 1]),
  359:     ok.
  360: 
  361: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal) ->
  362:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime, Ns}),
  363:     try enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000)
  364:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime, Ns}) end.
  365: 
  366: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline) ->
  367:     case quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, Goal) of
  368:         {ok, [_], _} -> ok;
  369:         _ -> receive
  370:             {proof_ready, {Ns, _}, _, _, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline);
  371:             {replay_ready, {Ns, _}, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline)
  372:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) -> error({enrollment_not_ready, Ns})
  373:         end
  374:     end.
  375: 
  376: remote_signed_transaction_savepoints(Config) ->
  377:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  378:     %% Fresh callable names cannot be made accidentally executable by a
  379:     %% previously loaded test beam or another proof's atom allocation.
  380:     Suffix = integer_to_binary(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
  381:     Removed = <<"tx_wire_removed_", Suffix/binary>>,
  382:     Kept = <<"tx_wire_kept_", Suffix/binary>>,
  383:     LocalChoices = <<"tx_wire_local_choices_", Suffix/binary>>,
  384:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(assertz(", LocalChoices,
  385:       "(0)), assertz((", LocalChoices, "(N) :- N > 0, M is N - 1, "
  386:       "((assertz(", Removed, "(N)), fail); \\+ ", Removed, "(N)), ",
  387:       LocalChoices, "(M))))."]),
  388:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
  389:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
  390:     Failed = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(transaction((assertz(", Removed,
  391:       "(1)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(1)), fail)); true)."]),
  392:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
  393:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Failed)),
  394:     Fallback = iolist_to_binary(["animals::transaction((third::true, ",
  395:       LocalChoices, "(1200), ((assertz(", Removed,
  396:       "(2)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(2)), fail); (assertz(", Kept,
  397:       "(3)), ", LocalChoices, "(1200), third::assertz(", Kept, "(3))))))."]),
  398:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  399:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Fallback)),
  400:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  401:         RemoveAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Removed, utf8]),
  402:         KeepAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Kept, utf8]),
  403:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {RemoveAtom, {'X'}}])),
  404:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {KeepAtom, 3}]))
  405:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  406: 
  407: cut_findall_local_and_cohosted(Config) ->
  408:     Peer = ?config(target, Config),
  409:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  410:     lists:foreach(fun(Inner) ->
  411:         Goal = {findall, X, {';', {',', Inner, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, {'L'}},
  412:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [1]}], _},
  413:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Goal], 60000))
  414:     end, [Choices, {'::', ?FOURTH_NS, Choices}]).
  415: 
  416: cut_findall_remote_boundaries(Config) ->
  417:     Peer = ?config(asker, Config),
  418:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  419:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, Choices},
  420:     Cases = [
  421:       {{';', Remote, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 2, 3]},
  422:       {{';', {'::', ?NS, {',', Choices, '!'}}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  423:       {{';', {',', Remote, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1]},
  424:       {{';', {',', {'::', ?NS, {'\\+', {',', '!', fail}}}, {'=', X, 1}},
  425:                {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  426:       {{'::', ?NS, {';', {'->', {',', '!', fail}, {'=', X, 1}},
  427:                               {'=', X, 2}}}, [2]}],
  428:     lists:foreach(fun({Inner, Expected}) ->
  429:         Goal = {findall, X, Inner, {'L'}},
  430:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := Expected}], _},
  431:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000))
  432:     end, Cases).
  433: 
  434: cut_findall_signed_multiscope_savepoints(Config) ->
  435:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  436:     %% Genuine signed requests and target commits, not an intent or overlay
  437:     %% shortcut. Ordinary collection retains staged writes; transaction
  438:     %% checkpoints remove failed-candidate writes on both remote scopes.
  439:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  440:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
  441:         <<"animals::findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_keep(X)), third::assertz(cut_keep(X)), !), [1]).">>)),
  442:     Rollback = submit_signed_execute(Config,
  443:         <<"animals::((transaction((findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_remove(X)), third::assertz(cut_remove(X)), !), [1]), fail))); X=rolled_back).">>),
  444:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}}, Rollback),
  445:     {ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [RollbackBinding]}}} = Rollback,
  446:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, rolled_back}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(RollbackBinding)),
  447:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  448:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 1}])),
  449:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 2}])),
  450:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_remove, {'X'}}]))
  451:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  452: 
  453: init_per_suite(Config) ->
  454:     {TargetPub, _} = TargetKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  455:     {AskerPub, _} = AskerKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  456:     {ThirdPub, _} = ThirdKey = key_before(TargetPub),
  457:     {AgentPub, _} = AgentKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  458:     TargetAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?TARGET_PORT},
  459:     AskerAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  460:     ThirdAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?THIRD_PORT},
  461:     Animals = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/animals.pl"),
  462:     Pets = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/pets.pl"),
  463:     {ok, AnimalsBin} = file:read_file(Animals),
  464:     {ok, PetsBin} = file:read_file(Pets),
  465:     FilterSymbolName =
  466:         <<"quod_r4_target_only_",
  467:           (binary:encode_hex(crypto:strong_rand_bytes(8)))/binary>>,
  468:     TargetGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_animals.pl"),
  469:     ok = file:write_file(
  470:            TargetGenesis,
  471:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, "
  472:             "human_user(test_agent)), _Chain, _Ns).\n",
  473:             AnimalsBin,
  474:             "\necho(X).\n",
  475:             FilterSymbolName, "(opaque).\n",
  476:             "blocked(X) :- fail_with_reason(impossible_to_link(X)).\n",
  477:             "via_third_failure :- third::third_blocked.\n",
  478:             "via_fourth(X) :- third::via_fourth(X).\n",
  479:             "dtx_write_chain(X) :- assertz(dtx_animals_mark(X)), "
  480:             "third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  481:             dtx_disjoint_target_rules(),
  482:             "conflict_version(0).\n"
  483:             "dtx_conflicting_write(X) :- conflict_version(_), "
  484:             "retract(conflict_version(0)), assertz(conflict_version(X)), "
  485:             "assertz(dtx_conflict_mark(X)), third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  486:             deep_failure_rules(),
  487:             "loop :- loop.\n"]),
  488:     TargetAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  489:                     ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub]},
  490:     Target = start_node(target, ?TARGET_PORT, TargetKey, ?NS,
  491:                         TargetGenesis, [], TargetAllow, Config),
  492:     ThirdGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_third.pl"),
  493:     ok = file:write_file(
  494:            ThirdGenesis,
  495:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  496:             "third_blocked :- fail_with_reason(third_declined).\n"
  497:             "via_fourth(X) :- fourth::leaf(X).\n"
  498:             "dtx_write(X) :- assertz(dtx_third_mark(X)).\n",
  499:             dtx_disjoint_third_rules()]),
  500:     ThirdAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  501:                    ?NS => [TargetPub]},
  502:     Third = start_node(third, ?THIRD_PORT, ThirdKey, ?THIRD_NS,
  503:                        ThirdGenesis, [], ThirdAllow, Config),
  504:     FourthGenesis = filename:join(
  505:                       ?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_fourth.pl"),
  506:     ok = file:write_file(
  507:            FourthGenesis,
  508:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  509:             "leaf(ok).\n"]),
  510:     start_namespace(
  511:       Target, TargetPub, ?FOURTH_NS, FourthGenesis, [], Config),
  512:     PrivateGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_private.pl"),
  513:     %% Policy belongs in GENESIS. `can_invoke/4` gates every scope entry —
  514:     %% including a top-level prove on this node — so an ontology born without a
  515:     %% clause could never be given one: it would deny the very proof that would
  516:     %% assert its policy. An empty chain is this host's own entry, which is
  517:     %% allowed so the ontology is usable at all; the restrictive clauses for
  518:     %% remote callers are asserted through it below.
  519:     ok = file:write_file(
  520:            PrivateGenesis,
  521:            ["can_join(_Ns, _Addr, Pk) :- peer_ready(Pk).\n",
  522:             "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, [], _Ns).\n",
  523:             "secret(42).\n"
  524:             "hidden(99).\n"]),
  525:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?PRIVATE_NS, PrivateGenesis, [], Config),
  526:     start_root_namespace(Target, TargetPub, Config),
  527:     start_brahms(Target, ?NS, TargetAddr, []),
  528:     DirectoryAllow = #{?NS => [ThirdPub, TargetPub],
  529:                        ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub],
  530:                        ?ROOT_NS => [TargetPub]},
  531:     AskerGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_pets.pl"),
  532:     AgentKeySource = prolog_binary_literal(AgentPub),
  533:     ok = file:write_file(
  534:            AskerGenesis,
  535:            ["agent_key(human_user(test_agent), ", AgentKeySource,
  536:             ", active).\n",
  537:             %% Only a goal which also writes A is locally authorized here.
  538:             %% Exact remote selectors deliberately have no matching A policy;
  539:             %% the target ontology alone must authorize its predicate.
  540:             "can_invoke((assertz(signed_pets_mark(_)), _), "
  541:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  542:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  543:             "can_invoke((instance_of(pet, my_dog), _), "
  544:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  545:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  546:             "can_invoke(independent(_), "
  547:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  548:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n"
  549:             "can_invoke((_;_), "
  550:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  551:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  552:             PetsBin,
  553:             "\nrecover_third_failure :- animals::via_third_failure ; "
  554:             "get_fail_reasons([_, _, _, _, third_declined]).\n"]),
  555:     Asker = start_node(asker, ?ASKER_PORT, AskerKey, ?ASKER_NS,
  556:                        AskerGenesis,
  557:                        [TargetAddr], DirectoryAllow, Config),
  558:     TargetAnchor = peer:call(
  559:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  560:     ThirdAnchor = peer:call(
  561:                     Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS]),
  562:     FourthAnchor = peer:call(
  563:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]),
  564:     AskerAnchor = peer:call(
  565:                      Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ASKER_NS]),
  566:     RootAnchor = peer:call(
  567:                    Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ROOT_NS]),
  568:     NetworkId = RootAnchor,
  569:     lists:foreach(
  570:       fun(Peer) -> set_network_identity(Peer, NetworkId) end,
  571:       [Target, Asker, Third]),
  572:     %% Root's seed/spec requires a local replica before durable effects.
  573:     %% The old fixture declared its anchor as locally desired on every peer
  574:     %% but left Asker/Third without the corresponding owner. R2 correctly
  575:     %% treats that as unavailable local history, never as foreign permission.
  576:     %% Pin the refusal, then establish real non-voting replicas. Root writes
  577:     %% and effect custody still execute on Target, its sole validator.
  578:     start_brahms(Target, ?ROOT_NS, TargetAddr, []),
  579:     lists:foreach(fun({RootPeer, RootPub, RootAddr}) ->
  580:         ?assertEqual(undefined,
  581:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ROOT_NS}])),
  582:         RootDeadline = peer:call(RootPeer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 1000,
  583:         ?assertEqual({error, not_ready}, peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex,
  584:             history_view_at, [{?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor}, 1, RootDeadline])),
  585:         start_join_namespace(RootPeer, RootPub, ?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  586:         start_brahms(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, RootAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  587:         wait_ready(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, {effect_custody_limits, 64, unlimited}),
  588:         ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},
  589:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS]))
  590:     end, [{Asker, AskerPub, AskerAddr}, {Third, ThirdPub, ThirdAddr}]),
  591:     %% The third node is a real, fully synchronized observer of `animals`.
  592:     %% Its key sorts before the sole validator so the live selection tests
  593:     %% below would choose it first if advertised roles were trusted.
  594:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_quic, learn, [TargetPub, TargetAddr]),
  595:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_quic, learn, [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr]),
  596:     start_join_namespace(
  597:       Third, ThirdPub, ?NS, TargetAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  598:     start_brahms(Third, ?NS, ThirdAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  599:     AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor,
  600:                 {human_user, test_agent}},
  601:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  602:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  603:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  604:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator},
  605:                   {?FOURTH_NS, FourthAnchor, validator},
  606:                   {?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  607:     %% Start with the controller-relay topology. Atomic commit cases establish
  608:     %% B's C route explicitly: Resolve verifies every role's certified Vote,
  609:     %% not just the origin's. Scope selection itself remains owned by A.
  610:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  611:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  612:                 [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr,
  613:                  [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  614:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}], 1, 1]),
  615:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  616:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  617:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  618:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  619:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  620:                 Target, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  621:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  622:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  623:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  624:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  625:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  626:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  627:     %% Private reachability is the local projection of an exact committed
  628:     %% HostNodeRef.  The target ontology's public route supplies that host's
  629:     %% current endpoint; the private ontology itself is never advertised.
  630:     PrivateAnchor = peer:call(
  631:                       Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
  632:     HostNodeRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, TargetAnchor, target_node},
  633:     ok = peer:call(
  634:            Asker, quod_directory, install_private_projection,
  635:            [[#{namespace => ?PRIVATE_NS, anchor => PrivateAnchor,
  636:                host_node_ref => HostNodeRef}]]),
  637:     %% The origin, not the currently executing B scope, selects C for A→B→C.
  638:     %% B therefore has no C route; this exercises the authenticated controller
  639:     %% relay and target-only atom materialization path.
  640:     %% C was installed above through the same candidate path.
  641:     start_brahms(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  642:     start_brahms(Third, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAddr, []),
  643:     %% Root's ordinary Prolog policy, not the transport fixture, grants this
  644:     %% exact durable agent permission to create an ontology.  The signed
  645:     %% remote-effect case below must still pass Root's normal can_invoke and
  646:     %% can_create_ontology rules.
  647:     ?assertMatch(
  648:        {ok, [_], _},
  649:        peer:call(
  650:          Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  651:          [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creator_agent, AgentRef}}],
  652:          60000)),
  653:     AuthPid = peer:call(Asker, erlang, whereis, [quod_client_auth]),
  654:     true = is_pid(AuthPid),
  655:     ClientPeer = {127, 0, 0, 1},
  656:     Session = open_client_session(
  657:                 Asker, NetworkId, AskerPub, AgentKey, ClientPeer),
  658:     wait_ready(Target, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  659:     wait_ready(Third, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  660:     wait_ready(Target, ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, 42}),
  661:     wait_ready(Third, ?THIRD_NS,
  662:                {can_invoke, probe, anonymous, [], ?THIRD_NS}),
  663:     wait_ready(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {instance_of, pet, my_dog}),
  664:     %% `can_invoke/4` receives the authenticated principal and the whole
  665:     %% origin-built chain at once, so a restrictive policy names both itself.
  666:     %% `secret/1` admits the real node key; `hidden/1` deliberately names a
  667:     %% different one, so the negative case still proves that an ontology name
  668:     %% in the chain cannot launder its transport.
  669:     ACLs = [
  670:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {secret, {'X'}}, {node, AskerPub},
  671:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}},
  672:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {hidden, {'X'}}, {node, <<0:256>>},
  673:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}}
  674:     ],
  675:     lists:foreach(
  676:       fun(ACL) ->
  677:           ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _},
  678:                        peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  679:                                  [?PRIVATE_NS, ACL], 60000))
  680:       end, ACLs),
  681:     [{target, Target}, {asker, Asker}, {third, Third},
  682:      {target_pub, TargetPub}, {asker_pub, AskerPub},
  683:      {target_addr, TargetAddr}, {third_pub, ThirdPub},
  684:      {third_addr, ThirdAddr}, {network_id, NetworkId},
  685:      {target_anchor, TargetAnchor}, {third_anchor, ThirdAnchor},
  686:      {fourth_anchor, FourthAnchor},
  687:      {asker_anchor, AskerAnchor}, {filter_symbol_name, FilterSymbolName},
  688:      {agent_ref, AgentRef},
  689:      {agent_key, AgentKey}, {agent_pub, AgentPub},
  690:      {client_peer, ClientPeer}, {client_session, Session},
  691:      {client_auth, AuthPid} | Config].
  692: 
  693: end_per_suite(Config) ->
  694:     _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || P <- [?config(target, Config),
  695:                                       ?config(asker, Config),
  696:                                       ?config(third, Config)]],
  697:     ok.
  698: 
  699: %% A real, caught-up observer can answer the ontology locally, but an
  700: %% advertised observer row is never eligible to answer a single-host remote
  701: %% read. The sole current validator must own the live scope.
  702: remote_plain_read_excludes_live_observer(Config) ->
  703:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  704:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  705:     Observer = ?config(third, Config),
  706:     ObserverKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  707:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  708:     ?assert(lists:any(
  709:               fun(#{node_key := Key, role := observer}) ->
  710:                       Key =:= ObserverKey;
  711:                  (_) -> false
  712:               end, Routes)),
  713:     ?assertMatch(
  714:        {ok, [_], _},
  715:        peer:call(Observer, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  716:                  [?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}], 5000)),
  717:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  718:     AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  719:     assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Observer),
  720:     ?assertEqual(
  721:        AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  722:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)).
  723: 
  724: %% Native preparation needs the selected physical host, including an observer.
  725: %% It uses the ordinary authenticated scope wire, in an isolated read-only
  726: %% context; it cannot supply ordinary material reads or execute the signed goal.
  727: remote_native_read_uses_selected_observer(Config) ->
  728:     Asker = ?config(asker,Config), Observer = ?config(third,Config),
  729:     Key = ?config(third_pub,Config), Identity = {?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config)},
  730:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},peer:call(Observer,quod_simplex,status,[?NS])),
  731:     {Bytes,Signature} = signed_goal_request(?config(network_id,Config),
  732:         ?config(agent_pub,Config),?config(agent_key,Config),?ASKER_NS,
  733:         ?config(asker_anchor,Config),quod_time:now_ms()+30000,execute,
  734:         <<"assertz(signed_pets_mark(987654321)).">>),
  735:     {ok,Evidence} = quod_client_goal:verify(Bytes,Signature),
  736:     Auth = quod_client_goal:request_auth(Evidence),
  737:     Read = fun(Target,Goal) ->
  738:         Deadline = peer:call(Asker,quod_time,mono_ms,[]) + 10000,
  739:         peer:call(Asker,quod_ask,native_read,[Key,Target,Goal,Auth,Deadline],15000)
  740:     end,
  741:     Operation = maps:get(operation_ref,Evidence),
  742:     Target = ?config(target,Config),
  743:     #{proves := ObserverBefore} = peer:call(Observer,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS]),
  744:     #{proves := TargetBefore} = peer:call(Target,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS]),
  745:     ?assertEqual({ok,{current_request_operation,Operation}},Read(Identity,{current_request_operation,Operation})),
  746:     ?assertEqual(ObserverBefore+1,maps:get(proves,peer:call(Observer,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS]))),
  747:     ?assertMatch(#{proves := TargetBefore},peer:call(Target,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS])),
  748:     %% Observer service does not acquire a plan signer.
  749:     ?assertMatch({fail,_},Read(Identity,{current_executor_key,Key})),
  750:     ?assertEqual({ok,{via_fourth,ok}},Read(Identity,{via_fourth,ok})),
  751:     ?assertMatch({error,_},Read(Identity,{assertz,native_scope_write})),
  752:     ?assertMatch({error,_},Read({?NS,<<0:256>>},true)),
  753:     ?assertMatch({fail,_},peer:call(Observer,quod_prolog,prove_ro,[?NS,native_scope_write])),
  754:     assert_fact_absent(Asker,?ASKER_NS,signed_pets_mark,987654321).
  755:

  757: %% GUI material owners remain on Asker; its native receiver is a separate node
  758: %% serving only an observer replica of the GUI capability. No Human replica or
  759: %% responder is installed on that connection host.
  760: remote_gui_opening_observer_receiver(Config) ->
  761:     Owner = ?config(asker,Config), Receiver = ?config(third,Config),
  762:     OwnerKey = ?config(asker_pub,Config), ReceiverKey = ?config(third_pub,Config),
  763:     OwnerAddr = {"127.0.0.1",?ASKER_PORT}, ReceiverAddr = {"127.0.0.1",?THIRD_PORT},
  764:     Source = fun(Name) -> quod_prolog:read_terms(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),"ontologies/" ++ Name)) end,
  765:     Start = fun(Ns,Terms,Modules) ->
  766:         Dir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),binary_to_list(Ns)),
  767:         peer:call(Owner,?MODULE,gui_found_namespace,[Ns,#{node_id => OwnerKey,
  768:             mode => create,data_dir => Dir,external_predicate_modules => Modules,
  769:             genesis_diff => quod_prolog:terms_to_diff(Terms)}],15000)
  770:     end,
  771:     GuiNs = <<"quod:gui">>, NodeNs = <<"gui:remote-node">>, AppNs = <<"gui:remote-app">>,
  772:     GuiAnchor = Start(GuiNs,quod_ct:gui_terms() ++ [{can_invoke,true,{'_'},{'_'},GuiNs}],
  773:                       [quod_agent_predicates,quod_gui_predicates]),
  774:     AgentAnchor = Start(<<"quod:agent">>,Source("quod_agent.pl"),[quod_agent_predicates]),
  775:     UserAnchor = Start(<<"quod:user">>,Source("quod_user.pl"),[quod_agent_predicates]),
  776:     start_brahms(Owner,GuiNs,OwnerAddr,[]),
  777:     start_join_namespace(Receiver,ReceiverKey,GuiNs,GuiAnchor,[OwnerAddr],Config),
  778:     start_brahms(Receiver,GuiNs,ReceiverAddr,[OwnerAddr]),
  779:     ok = peer:call(Receiver,?MODULE,enrollment_wait_ready,[GuiNs,true],15000),
  780:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},peer:call(Receiver,quod_simplex,status,[GuiNs])),
  781:     HumanNs = <<"gui:remote-human">>, HumanInstance = {human_user,test_agent},
  782:     HumanAnchor = Start(HumanNs,quod_gui_question_tests:user_source_with_allowance(HumanInstance,2) ++ [
  783:         {agent_key,HumanInstance,?config(agent_pub,Config),active},
  784:         {instance_of,{':',quod,{':',user,human_user}},HumanInstance},
  785:         {can_invoke,{'_'},{agent_instance_ref,HumanNs,{'_'},HumanInstance},{'_'},HumanNs}],
  786:         [quod_agent_predicates]),
  787:     Human = {agent_instance_ref,HumanNs,HumanAnchor,HumanInstance},
  788:     Ctx = #{agent => {HumanNs,HumanAnchor},key_pair => ?config(agent_key,Config),
  789:             network => ?config(network_id,Config)},
  790:     Admin = {can_invoke,{'_'},Human,{'_'},{'_'}},
  791:     NodeAnchor = Start(NodeNs,Source("node_instance.pl") ++ [Admin,
  792:         {can_invoke,{'_'},{node,OwnerKey},{'_'},NodeNs},
  793:         {node_ontology,NodeNs},{instance_of,node,physical_node},{agent_key,physical_node,OwnerKey,active}],
  794:         [quod_agent_predicates]),
  795:     Node = {agent_instance_ref,NodeNs,NodeAnchor,physical_node},
  796:     {ok,#{start := {quod_ns,start_link,[?ROOT_NS,RootCfg]}}} = peer:call(Owner,supervisor,get_childspec,
  797:         [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup,node}),{quod_ns,?ROOT_NS}]),
  798:     ok = peer:call(Owner,application,set_env,[quod,namespace_static_content,#{?ROOT_NS => RootCfg}]),
  799:     ok = peer:call(Owner,application,set_env,[quod,identity_dir,filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),"gui-node-identity")]),
  800:     ok = peer:call(Owner,application,set_env,[quod,content_data_dir,filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),binary_to_list(NodeNs))]),
  801:     ok = peer:call(Owner,supervisor,terminate_child,[quod_reg:via({sup,node}),quod_namespace_manager]),
  802:     {ok,_} = peer:call(Owner,supervisor,restart_child,[quod_reg:via({sup,node}),quod_namespace_manager]),
  803:     ok = peer:call(Owner,?MODULE,gui_bind_node,[NodeNs,NodeAnchor],15000),
  804:     Unlock = filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),"remote-gui-unlock"),
  805:     ok = quod_file:write_atomic(Unlock,crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),8#600),
  806:     VaultConfig = #{directory => filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),"remote-gui-keys"),unlock_file => Unlock},
  807:     ok = peer:call(Owner,application,set_env,[quod,agent_vault,VaultConfig]),
  808:     {ok,_} = peer:call(Owner,supervisor,restart_child,[quod_reg:via({sup,node}),quod_agent_vault]),
  809:     AppAnchor = Start(AppNs,Source("agent_instance.pl") ++ Source("gui_instance.pl") ++
  810:         quod_prolog:read_terms(filename:join([
  811:             filename:dirname(code:which(?MODULE)),"fixtures","gui-components.pl"])) ++ [Admin,
  812:         {instance_of,{':',quod,{':',agent,agent}},actor},
  813:         {can_invoke,{'_'},{node,OwnerKey},{'_'},AppNs},
  814:         {gui_vocabulary,GuiNs,GuiAnchor},{gui_pending_allowance,actor,2},{gui_completion_allowance,actor,30000},
  815:         {can_assign_agent_host,Human,actor,none,0,Node,{'_'}},
  816:         {':-',{settings_entered,{'N'},{'M'},{'L'},{'A'}},{assertz,{saved,{'N'},{'M'},{'L'},{'A'}}}}],
  817:         [quod_agent_predicates,quod_agent_work_predicates]),
  818:     Actor = {agent_instance_ref,AppNs,AppAnchor,actor},
  819:     Ref = {form_ref,AppNs,AppAnchor,settings},
  820:     Scope = fun(Ns,Anchor,Goal) -> {'::',Ns,{',',{current_ontology_identity,Ns,Anchor},Goal}} end,
  821:     Submit = fun(Goal) -> peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,submit,[Ctx,execute,Goal],60000) end,
  822:     {ok,ActorBlob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Actor),
  823:     {ok,Key} = peer:call(Owner,quod_agent_vault,prepare,[ActorBlob,0]),
  824:     ok = peer:call(Owner,?MODULE,gui_host_actor,[Ctx,Actor,Node,Key],30000),
  825:     lists:foreach(fun(Term) ->
  826:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},Submit(Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{assertz,Term})))
  827:     end,[{gui_question_policy,settings,Human,Actor},{gui_responder_policy,actor,Ref,Human}]),
  828:     ok = enrollment_route(Receiver,OwnerKey,OwnerAddr,
  829:         [{?ASKER_NS,?config(asker_anchor,Config),validator},
  830:          {HumanNs,HumanAnchor,validator},{GuiNs,GuiAnchor,validator},
  831:          {NodeNs,NodeAnchor,validator},{AppNs,AppAnchor,validator},
  832:          {<<"quod:agent">>,AgentAnchor,validator},{<<"quod:user">>,UserAnchor,validator}]),
  833:     ok = enrollment_route(Owner,ReceiverKey,ReceiverAddr,
  834:         [{?THIRD_NS,?config(third_anchor,Config),validator},{?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),observer},
  835:          {GuiNs,GuiAnchor,observer}]),
  836:     ?assertEqual(undefined,peer:call(Receiver,quod_reg,where,[{quod_prolog,HumanNs}])),
  837:     ?assertEqual(undefined,peer:call(Receiver,quod_reg,where,[{quod_prolog,AppNs}])),
  838:     ?assertMatch({ok,[#{<<"V0">> := []}],_},peer:call(Receiver,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  839:         [Ctx,Scope(HumanNs,HumanAnchor,gui({gui_pending_questions,{0}}))],20000)),
  840:     Client = peer:call(Receiver,?MODULE,gui_receiver_start,[Ctx,HumanNs,HumanAnchor]),
  841:     ReceiverCall = fun(Command) -> peer:call(Receiver,gen_server,call,[Client,Command,20000],25000) end,
  842:     try
  843:         #{<<"receiver">> := #{<<"token">> := TokenText}} = ReceiverCall(renew),
  844:         Token = base64:decode(TokenText,#{mode => urlsafe,padding => false}),
  845:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},
  846:             Submit(gui({gui_select_receiver,Human,ReceiverKey,Token}))),
  847:         _ = ReceiverCall(renew),
  848:         Opening = Submit(gui({gui_open,Ref,{0}})),
  849:         case Opening of
  850:             {ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}} -> ok;
  851:             {ok,_,Outcome} -> error({remote_gui_open_failed,Outcome});
  852:             Other -> error({remote_gui_open_failed,Other})
  853:         end,
  854:         ok = ReceiverCall(activated),
  855:         {ok,[#{<<"V0">> := [{question_ref,AppNs,AppAnchor,Q}]}],_} =
  856:             peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,[Ctx,gui({gui_pending_questions,{0}})]),
  857:         {ok,[#{<<"V0">> := Revision}],_} = peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  858:             [Ctx,Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{gui_schema,settings,{0},{'_'}})]),
  859:         Fields = [{field,name,<<"Remote">>},{field,mode,square},{field,level,75},{field,angle,180}],
  860:         ok = peer:call(Owner,?MODULE,gui_complete_answer,
  861:             [Ctx,Actor,Q,gui({gui_submit,{question_ref,AppNs,AppAnchor,Q},Revision,apply,Fields})],30000),
  862:         ?assertMatch({ok,[_],_},peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  863:             [Ctx,Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{saved,<<"Remote">>,square,75,180})])),
  864:         #{<<"value">> := <<"[]">>} = ReceiverCall(renew),
  865:         ok = ReceiverCall(stop),
  866:         %% The signed route remains, but the authoritative remote receiver is
  867:         %% absent. Public opening fails and creates no question or HUD row.
  868:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{failed,_}}},Submit(gui({gui_open,Ref,{0}}))),
  869:         ?assertMatch({ok,[#{<<"V0">> := []}],_},peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  870:             [Ctx,gui({gui_pending_questions,{0}})]))
  871:     after
  872:         _ = catch ReceiverCall(stop)
  873:     end.

  875: gui_found_namespace(Ns,Config) ->
  876:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime,Ns}),
  877:     try
  878:         {ok,_} = quod_ns_sup:start_namespace(Ns,Config),
  879:         receive {replay_ready,_,_} -> quod_simplex:genesis_hash(Ns)
  880:         after 10000 -> error({gui_namespace_not_ready,Ns}) end
  881:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime,Ns}) end.
  882: 
  883: gui_bind_node(Ns,Anchor) ->
  884:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({node_actor,node}),
  885:     try
  886:         {ok,Principal} = quod_node_actor:bind(Ns,Anchor,<<"physical_node.">>,3),
  887:         receive {node_actor_installed,_,{ok,Principal}} -> ok
  888:         after 10000 -> error(gui_node_not_installed) end
  889:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({node_actor,node}) end.
  890: 
  891: %% peer uses standard_io with a nondistributed CT parent. Keep socket delivery
  892: %% and its processing barriers inside the receiver VM; RPC carries assertions.
  893: gui_receiver_start(Ctx,Ns,Anchor) ->
  894:     Session = quod_gui_question_tests:gui_session(Ctx),
  895:     spawn(fun() ->
  896:         Parent = self(),
  897:         {Hud,M} = spawn_monitor(fun() -> quod_gui_question_tests:gui_socket(Parent,#{peer => {127,0,0,1}},true) end),
  898:         Message = fun() -> quod_gui_question_tests:gui_open_message(Ctx,Session,gui_hud,Ns,Anchor,none,0) end,
  899:         gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message)
  900:     end).
  901: 
  902: gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message) ->
  903:     receive
  904:         {'$gen_call',From,renew} ->
  905:             Hud ! {client,Message()},
  906:             Projection = gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,quod_time:mono_ms()+15000),
  907:             gen_server:reply(From,Projection),gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message);
  908:         {'$gen_call',From,activated} ->
  909:             receive {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"gui_prepare">>}} -> ok
  910:             after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_prepare_missing) end,
  911:             receive {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"gui_activate">>}} -> ok
  912:             after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_activation_missing) end,
  913:             gen_server:reply(From,ok),gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message);
  914:         {'$gen_call',From,stop} ->
  915:             Hud ! stop,
  916:             receive {'DOWN',M,process,Hud,normal} -> gen_server:reply(From,ok)
  917:             after 5000 -> error(remote_gui_not_closed) end;
  918:         {'DOWN',M,process,Hud,Reason} -> error({remote_gui_socket_down,Reason})
  919:     end.
  920: 
  921: gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,Deadline) ->
  922:     receive
  923:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"projection">>} = Projection} -> Projection;
  924:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"refresh">>}} ->
  925:             Hud ! {client,Message()},gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,Deadline);
  926:         %% Like the portable signed-view client, wait for the owner's refresh
  927:         %% when an earlier subscription is still being retired. No retry timer.
  928:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"unavailable">>,
  929:                         <<"reason">> := <<"dependency_recovering">>}} ->
  930:             gui_receiver_projection(Hud,Message,Deadline);
  931:         {gui_view,Hud,Other} -> error({remote_gui_projection_failed,Other})
  932:     after max(0,Deadline-quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  933:         Ref = make_ref(),Hud ! {inspect,Ref},
  934:         receive {Ref,State} -> error({remote_gui_projection_missing,
  935:             maps:with([installed,pending,follows,follow_requests,owners,local_ready],State),
  936:             quod_foreign_log:stats()})
  937:         after 1000 -> error(remote_gui_socket_unresponsive) end
  938:     end.
  939: 
  940: gui_host_actor(Ctx,Actor = {agent_instance_ref,Ns,_,_},Node,Key) ->
  941:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent_hosting,Ns}),
  942:     try
  943:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},quod_lobby_tests:submit(Ctx,execute,
  944:             {'::',<<"quod:agent">>,{goal,{agent_hosted,Actor,Node,1,Key}}})),
  945:         receive {agent_installed,_,_,#{reference := Actor},_} -> ok
  946:         after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_actor_not_installed) end
  947:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent_hosting,Ns}) end.
  948: 
  949: gui_complete_answer(Ctx,Actor = {agent_instance_ref,Ns,Anchor,_},Q,Goal) ->
  950:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent,Actor}),
  951:     try
  952:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},quod_lobby_tests:submit(Ctx,execute,Goal)),
  953:         receive {agent_request_finished,_,_,#{reference := Actor},_,Result} ->
  954:             {ok,#{request_bytes := Bytes},{normalized,{committed,_,_}}} = Result,
  955:             {ok,#{goal_text := Text}} = quod_client_goal:decode(Bytes),
  956:             {ok,Expected} = quod_client_goal_parser:format(gui({gui_complete,{question_ref,Ns,Anchor,Q}})),
  957:             ?assertEqual(quod_client_goal_parser:parse(Expected,3),quod_client_goal_parser:parse(Text,3)),ok
  958:         after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_completion_missing) end
  959:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent,Actor}) end.
  960: 
  961: %% The same live observer now lies in its next signed directory generation and
  962: %% labels itself a validator. Its key sorts before the real validator, so a
  963: %% role-trusting selector would open the scope there. The certified target
  964: %% committee removes it and resolution reaches the honest coexisting route.
  965: remote_plain_read_rejects_lying_validator(Config) ->
  966:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  967:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  968:     Liar = ?config(third, Config),
  969:     LiarKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  970:     LiarEndpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
  971:     TargetKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  972:     TargetAnchor = ?config(target_anchor, Config),
  973:     ThirdAnchor = ?config(third_anchor, Config),
  974:     LyingRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  975:                  {?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}],
  976:     HonestRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  977:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}],
  978:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  979:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  980:                 [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, LyingRows, 1, 2]),
  981:     try
  982:         {known, Routes} = peer:call(
  983:                             Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  984:         ValidatorKeys = [Key || #{role := validator, node_key := Key} <- Routes],
  985:         ?assertEqual([LiarKey, TargetKey], ValidatorKeys),
  986:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  987:         AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  988:         assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Liar),
  989:         ?assertEqual(
  990:            AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  991:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config))
  992:     after
  993:         {ok, _} = peer:call(
  994:                     Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  995:                     [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, HonestRows, 1, 3])
  996:     end.
  997: 
  998: assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Validator, RefusedHost) ->
  999:     wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 200),
 1000:     wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200),
 1001:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1002:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1003:                        [quod_prolog, prove_ro, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1004:     try
 1005:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 1, 1500),
 1006:         ?assertEqual(0, scope_worker_count(RefusedHost))
 1007:     after
 1008:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1009:         wait_engine_stat(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, proof_workers, 0, 500),
 1010:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 500),
 1011:         wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200)
 1012:     end.
 1013: 
 1014: scope_worker_count(Peer) ->
 1015:     maps:get(scope_workers,
 1016:              peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [?NS]), undefined).
 1017: 
 1018: assert_symbol_opaque(Peer, SymbolName) ->
 1019:     ?assertEqual(
 1020:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
 1021:        peer:call(Peer, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
 1022: 
 1023: remote_scope_solutions(Config) ->
 1024:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1025:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, {'D'}}},
 1026:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _},
 1027:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000)),
 1028:     All = {findall, {'D'}, Goal, {'L'}},
 1029:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [{'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>},
 1030:                                   {'$quod_symbol', <<"meat">>}]}], _},
 1031:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, All], 60000)).
 1032: 
 1033: proof_policy_refusal_local_and_remote(Config) ->
 1034:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1035:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1036:     Ns = <<"proof-policy-refusal">>,
 1037:     Source = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "proof-policy-refusal.pl"),
 1038:     ok = file:write_file(Source,
 1039:         "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\nready.\n"),
 1040:     ok = start_namespace(Target, ?config(target_pub, Config), Ns, Source, [], Config),
 1041:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_ct, await_applied, [Ns, 1, 10000], 15000),
 1042:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1043:     AnimalsAnchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
 1044:     FourthAnchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]),
 1045:     ok = enrollment_route(Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1046:         [{Ns, Anchor, validator}, {?NS, AnimalsAnchor, validator},
 1047:          {?FOURTH_NS, FourthAnchor, validator},
 1048:          {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}]),
 1049:     Goal = {'::', Ns, ready},
 1050:     %% Establish both real routes before closing this disposable target's
 1051:     %% proof lane through its committed policy. No repair bypass is needed.
 1052:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1053:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _},
 1054:             peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1055:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 1056:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, execute,
 1057:         [Ns, {assertz, {material_limit_override, proof, heap_bytes, 0}}], 15000)),
 1058:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1059:         ?assertMatch({error, {material_limit, proof, heap_bytes, Actual, 0}}
 1060:                      when Actual > 0,
 1061:             peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1062:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]).
 1063: 
 1064: answer_policy_producer_consumer_and_signed_change(Config) ->
 1065:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1066:     Ns = <<"answer-policy-target">>, Value = binary:copy(<<"a">>, 80000),
 1067:     Source = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "answer-policy-target.pl"),
 1068:     ok = file:write_file(Source, [
 1069:         "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n",
 1070:         "material_limit_override(proof, answer_bytes, 1000).\n",
 1071:         "answer_value(<<\"", Value, "\">>).\n"]),
 1072:     ok = start_namespace(Target, ?config(target_pub, Config), Ns, Source, [], Config),
 1073:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_ct, await_applied, [Ns, 1, 10000], 15000),
 1074:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1075:     ok = enrollment_route(Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1076:         [{Ns, Anchor, validator}, {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), validator},
 1077:          {?FOURTH_NS, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]), validator},
 1078:          {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}]),
 1079:     Goal = {'::', Ns, {answer_value, {'Value'}}},
 1080:     {ok, Canonical} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical({answer_value, Value}),
 1081:     Actual = byte_size(Canonical),
 1082:     Expected = {error, {material_limit, proof, answer_bytes, Actual, 1000}},
 1083:     %% Same selected producer, direct/cohosted/remote consumers.
 1084:     ?assertEqual(Expected, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 1085:                                     [Ns, {answer_value, {'Value'}}], 15000)),
 1086:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1087:         ?assertEqual(Expected, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1088:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 1089:     %% Raise through the ordinary signed action, under the OLD committed policy.
 1090:     Selector = {'$quod_symbol', Ns},
 1091:     Raise = {'::', Selector, {',', {retract, {material_limit_override, proof, answer_bytes, 1000}},
 1092:                             {assertz, {material_limit_override, proof, answer_bytes, 120000}}}},
 1093:     {ok, RaiseText} = quod_client_goal_parser:format(Raise),
 1094:     {ok, _} = quod_client_goal_parser:parse(RaiseText, 1),
 1095:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1096:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, RaiseText)),
 1097:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Origin}) ->
 1098:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'Value' := Value}], _},
 1099:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove_ro, [Origin, Goal], 15000))
 1100:     end, [{Target, ?NS}, {Asker, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 1101:     %% The outer rule exposes no large binding. Its receiving proof must still
 1102:     %% account for the computed foreign answer before consuming/discarding it.
 1103:     Rule = {':-', answer_seen, {'::', Selector, {answer_value, {0}}}},
 1104:     {ok, RuleText} = quod_client_goal_parser:format({assertz, Rule}),
 1105:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1106:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, RuleText)),
 1107:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1108:     Read = fun() ->
 1109:         {Bytes, Sig} = signed_goal_request(?config(network_id, Config),
 1110:             ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1111:             ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1112:             read, <<"answer_seen.">>),
 1113:         peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1114:             [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Sig, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 60000)
 1115:     end,
 1116:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}}, Read()),
 1117:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1118:         submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1119:             <<"assertz(material_limit_override(proof, answer_bytes, 1000)).">>)),
 1120:     ?assertEqual(Expected, peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 1121:                                     [?ASKER_NS, answer_seen], 15000)),
 1122:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, Expected}}}, Read()),
 1123:     %% A remote allowance never grants local capacity. Restore via a new,
 1124:     %% explicitly intended small authorized action, not a replay of the read.
 1125:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
 1126:         submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1127:             <<"retract(material_limit_override(proof, answer_bytes, 1000)).">>)),
 1128:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}}, Read()).
 1129: 
 1130: remote_scope_trace_parentage(Config) ->
 1131:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1132:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1133:     %% These peers use standard_io, not Erlang distribution to the CT VM.
 1134:     %% All trace collection and monitoring stay on the owning peer; neither
 1135:     %% target loads this suite's intentionally caller-only vocabulary.
 1136:     Collector = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, start, []),
 1137:     try
 1138:         {Result, Public, Open, Directory, ScopeOpen, Request} = peer:call(
 1139:                                                                  Asker,
 1140:                                                                  quod_trace_fixture,
 1141:                                                                  prove,
 1142:                                                                  [?ASKER_NS,
 1143:                                                                   {'::', ?NS,
 1144:                                                                    {diet, dog,
 1145:                                                                     {'D'}}}],
 1146:                                                                  60000),
 1147:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _}, Result),
 1148:         ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Open#span.trace_id),
 1149:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Directory#span.parent_span_id),
 1150:         ?assertEqual(Directory#span.span_id, ScopeOpen#span.parent_span_id),
 1151:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Request#span.parent_span_id),
 1152:         Auth = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1153:                          [Collector, <<"quod.scope.authenticate">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1154:         InvokeOpen = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1155:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_open">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1156:         InvokeNext = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1157:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_next">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1158:         %% These spans are emitted by the actual remote authentication worker
 1159:         %% and target invocation worker, not by a codec-only fixture.
 1160:         lists:foreach(fun(Span) ->
 1161:             ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Span#span.trace_id),
 1162:             ?assertEqual(ScopeOpen#span.span_id, Span#span.parent_span_id),
 1163:             ?assert(Span#span.parent_span_is_remote),
 1164:             ?assert(Span#span.end_time >= Span#span.start_time)
 1165:         end, [Auth, InvokeOpen, InvokeNext])
 1166:     after
 1167:         ok = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, stop, [Collector])
 1168:     end.
 1169: 
 1170: remote_scope_symbol_safety(Config) ->
 1171:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1172:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1173:     Echo = {'::', ?NS, {echo, asker_only_symbol}},
 1174:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 1175:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1176:                            [?ASKER_NS, Echo], 60000)),
 1177:     ?assertEqual({ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"asker_only_symbol">>}},
 1178:                  peer:call(Target, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1179:                            [{0, <<"asker_only_symbol">>}])),
 1180:     Unknown = {'::', ?NS, {asker_only_predicate, x}},
 1181:     ?assertMatch({fail, [_ | _]},
 1182:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1183:                            [?ASKER_NS, Unknown], 60000)).
 1184: 
 1185: %% A retains the new predicate as an opaque symbol. C alone starts with its
 1186: %% fact. B materializes the spelling from a deliberately failing local branch
 1187: %% while leaving C's nested goal opaque, then C returns that same symbol. Both
 1188: %% simultaneous first-use requests must bind without a failed seed request.
 1189: remote_signed_fresh_nested_symbol(Config) ->
 1190:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1191:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1192:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1193:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1194:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1195:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1196:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1197:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1198:     RaceSuffix = integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
 1199:     RacePredicateText = "quod_fresh_race_" ++ RaceSuffix,
 1200:     RacePredicate = list_to_atom(RacePredicateText),
 1201:     ?assertMatch(
 1202:        {ok, [_], _},
 1203:        peer:call(
 1204:          Third, quod_prolog, prove,
 1205:          [?THIRD_NS, {assertz, {RacePredicate, ok}}], 60000)),
 1206:     RaceGoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1207:                      ["\"animals\"::((", RacePredicateText,
 1208:                       "(ok), fail); \"third\"::", RacePredicateText,
 1209:                       "(ok))."]),
 1210:     Requests =
 1211:         [signed_goal_request(
 1212:            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1213:            maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read, RaceGoalText)
 1214:          || _ <- [first, second]],
 1215:     Parent = self(),
 1216:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1217:     Workers =
 1218:         [spawn(
 1219:            fun() ->
 1220:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 1221:                Parent !
 1222:                    {RaceRef, Label,
 1223:                     peer:call(
 1224:                       Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1225:                       [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes,
 1226:                        RequestSignature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1227:            end)
 1228:          || {Label, {Bytes, RequestSignature}} <-
 1229:                 lists:zip([first, second], Requests)],
 1230:     lists:foreach(fun(Worker) -> Worker ! {RaceRef, go} end, Workers),
 1231:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1232:     lists:foreach(
 1233:       fun({_Label,
 1234:            {ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _Height, [_Answer]}}}}}) -> ok;
 1235:          ({Label, Other}) -> error({fresh_symbol_race_failed, Label, Other})
 1236:       end, Results).
 1237: 
 1238: remote_scope_chain_policy(Config) ->
 1239:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1240:     Allowed = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, {'X'}}},
 1241:     ?assertMatch(
 1242:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
 1243:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1244:                  [?ASKER_NS, Allowed], 60000)),
 1245:     %% A refusal crosses QUIC as ordinary logical failure carrying its bounded
 1246:     %% reason, so the caller can inspect it and branch — same contract as the
 1247:     %% co-hosted path.
 1248:     Denied = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {hidden, {'X'}}},
 1249:     {fail, DeniedReasons} =
 1250:         peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1251:                   [?ASKER_NS, Denied], 60000),
 1252:     ?assert(lists:member({not_allowed, ?PRIVATE_NS}, DeniedReasons)),
 1253:     ?assertMatch(
 1254:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
 1255:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1256:                  [?ASKER_NS, {';', Denied, Allowed}], 60000)),
 1257:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(
 1258:                         Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
 1259:     ?assert(Routes =/= []),
 1260:     ?assert(lists:all(
 1261:               fun(#{scope := private, status := confirmed}) -> true;
 1262:                  (_) -> false
 1263:               end, Routes)),
 1264:     ?assertEqual([], peer:call(
 1265:                        Asker, quod_directory, directory_hosts,
 1266:                        [?PRIVATE_NS])).
 1267: 
 1268: remote_scope_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1269:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1270:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {blocked, bob}},
 1271:     Recover = {';', Remote,
 1272:                {get_fail_reasons,
 1273:                 [{'Outer'}, {blocked, bob}, {impossible_to_link, bob}]}},
 1274:     ?assertMatch(
 1275:        {ok, [#{'Outer' := Remote}], _},
 1276:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1277:                  [?ASKER_NS, Recover], 60000)).
 1278: 
 1279: %% The C predicate name is compiled only on B/C. A relays it without allocating
 1280: %% an atom; C materializes it after authenticating the scoped command. A's
 1281: %% declared recovery rule then matches C's reason after it returns through B.
 1282: remote_scope_nested_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1283:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1284:     ?assertMatch(
 1285:        {ok, [#{}], _},
 1286:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1287:                  [?ASKER_NS, recover_third_failure], 60000)),
 1288:     ?assertEqual(
 1289:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"third_blocked">>}},
 1290:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1291:                  [{0, <<"third_blocked">>}])),
 1292:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1293:       Asker, ?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS,
 1294:       ?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1295:       <<"third_blocked">>).
 1296: 
 1297: remote_scope_deep_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1298:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1299:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {deep_failure, 70}},
 1300:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1301:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1302:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1303:     ?assert(length(Reasons) > 64),
 1304:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1305:     ?assertEqual({'$quod_symbol', <<"deep_bottom">>}, lists:last(Reasons)),
 1306:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1307:       Asker, ?config(target, Config), ?NS,
 1308:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1309:       <<"deep_bottom">>).
 1310: 
 1311: assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1312:   Asker, Host, Ns, HostKey, Endpoint, SymbolName) ->
 1313:     Anchor = peer:call(Host, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1314:     ?assertMatch(
 1315:        {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}}},
 1316:        peer:call(
 1317:          Asker, quod_foreign_log, current,
 1318:          [[{HostKey, [Endpoint]}], {Ns, Anchor}, 20000], 25000)),
 1319:     %% current/3 must be able to certify and retain the complete foreign
 1320:     %% history without interning that ontology's application vocabulary.
 1321:     ?assertEqual(
 1322:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
 1323:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
 1324: 
 1325: remote_scope_structural_reason_depth(Config) ->
 1326:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1327:     %% The wire codec chooses no nesting quota: a reason built at proof time
 1328:     %% crosses the remote proof boundary whole, without a truncation marker.
 1329:     {ok, Bottom} = peer:call(
 1330:                      Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1331:                      [{0, <<"deep_bottom">>}]),
 1332:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, deep_reason},
 1333:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1334:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1335:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1336:     Reason = lists:foldl(
 1337:                fun(_, Acc) -> [Acc] end, Bottom, lists:seq(1, 70)),
 1338:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1339:     ?assert(lists:member(Reason, Reasons)),
 1340:     ?assertNot(lists:member(fail_reasons_truncated, Reasons)),
 1341:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(Reasons)).
 1342: 
 1343: remote_scope_cancel(Config) ->
 1344:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1345:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1346:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1347:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1348:                        [quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1349:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 1, 200),
 1350:     true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1351:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
 1352: 
 1353: %% Scope commands share the bounded node-level router without sharing proof
 1354: %% state. Two full waves prove that completed scopes release every target worker
 1355: %% and leave the transport reusable for independent proofs.
 1356: remote_scope_transport_reuse(Config) ->
 1357:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1358:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1359:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}},
 1360:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, first),
 1361:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200),
 1362:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, second),
 1363:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).
