 1365: %% The selector owns this empty origin fixture snapshot on the originating peer;
 1366: %% its signed foreign scope reads the real target under that target's ACL.
 1367: committed_remote_read(Evidence = #{request := #{agent_namespace := Ns,
 1368:         agent_genesis_anchor := Anchor,not_after_ms := Expiry},goal := Frozen}) ->
 1369:     {ok,Goal} = quod_wire_term:materialize_symbols(Frozen),
 1370:     Est = quod_predicates:set_context(quod_ct:committed_kb([]),
 1371:                                      quod_predicates:proof_context(Ns,1,[])),
 1372:     quod_prolog:prove_est(Goal,Est,#{identity => {Ns,Anchor},height => 1,
 1373:         deadline_ms => quod_time:mono_ms() + max(0,Expiry-quod_time:now_ms()),
 1374:         evidence => Evidence}).
 1375: 
 1376: %% The browser is logged into A as an agent stored in A. Exact selectors reach
 1377: %% B through the ordinary scope path. A has no ACL clause for these goals, so
 1378: %% success proves that A authenticates identity while B alone authorizes B's
 1379: %% predicate.
 1380: remote_signed_gateway_read_execute_cursor(Config) ->
 1381:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1382:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1383:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1384:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1385:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1386:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1387:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1388:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1389: 
 1390:     {ReadBytes, ReadSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1391:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1392:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1393:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read,
 1394:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1395:     {ok, ReadEvidence,
 1396:      {normalized, {read, ReadDependencies, {answers, ReadHeight, ReadBlobs}}}} =
 1397:         peer:call(
 1398:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1399:           [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), ReadBytes, ReadSignature, Peer],
 1400:           60000),
 1401:     ?assertEqual({?ASKER_NS,AgentAnchor,ReadHeight},
 1402:         lists:keyfind(?ASKER_NS,1,[{N,A,H} || {N,A,H,_} <- ReadDependencies])),
 1403:     ?assertEqual({?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),
 1404:                   peer:call(?config(target,Config),quod_prolog,applied,[?NS])},
 1405:         lists:keyfind(?NS,1,[{N,A,H} || {N,A,H,_} <- ReadDependencies])),
 1406:     ?assert(lists:all(fun({_,_,_,Reads}) -> Reads =:= [] end,ReadDependencies)),
 1407:     {read,SelectorDependencies,{ok,_,_,_}} =
 1408:         peer:call(Asker,?MODULE,committed_remote_read,[ReadEvidence],60000),
 1409:     {?NS,_,_,RemoteReads} = lists:keyfind(?NS,1,SelectorDependencies),
 1410:     ?assert(quod_read_set:valid_pairs(RemoteReads)),
 1411:     ?assert(lists:any(fun
 1412:         ({{Symbol,2},_}) -> quod_wire_term:symbol_names(Symbol) =:= {ok,[<<"diet">>]};
 1413:         (_) -> false
 1414:     end,RemoteReads)),
 1415:     ?assertEqual(ReadBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, ReadEvidence)),
 1416:     ?assertEqual(ReadSignature, maps:get(signature, ReadEvidence)),
 1417:     ?assertEqual(
 1418:        [[{<<"D">>, kibble}]],
 1419:        [begin {ok, Binding} = quod_durable_term:decode_result(Blob), Binding end
 1420:         || Blob <- ReadBlobs]),
 1421:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1422:     ExecuteText = iolist_to_binary(
 1423:                     io_lib:format("assertz(gateway_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1424:     {ExecuteBytes, ExecuteSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1425:                                          NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1426:                                          ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1427:                                          maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1428:                                          execute,
 1429:                                          <<"\"animals\"::", ExecuteText/binary>>),
 1430:     {ok, ExecuteEvidence,
 1431:      {normalized,
 1432:       {committed, [_],
 1433:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = ExecuteTargetRef}}} =
 1434:         peer:call(
 1435:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1436:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), ExecuteBytes,
 1437:            ExecuteSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1438:     ?assertEqual(
 1439:        ExecuteTargetRef,
 1440:        completed_remote_operation(
 1441:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, ExecuteEvidence), 600)),
 1442:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_mark, Tag),
 1443: 
 1444:     CursorText =
 1445:         <<"\"animals\"::(diet(dog, D), assertz(gateway_choice(D))).">>,
 1446:     {CursorBytes, CursorSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1447:                                        NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1448:                                        ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1449:                                        maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1450:                                        cursor, CursorText),
 1451:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1452:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, FirstBlob}}} =
 1453:         peer:call(
 1454:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1455:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorBytes,
 1456:            CursorSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1457:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, kibble}]},
 1458:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(FirstBlob)),
 1459:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1460:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, SecondBlob}}} =
 1461:         peer:call(
 1462:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1463:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, next, Peer], 60000),
 1464:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, meat}]},
 1465:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(SecondBlob)),
 1466:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1467:      {normalized,
 1468:       {committed, [_],
 1469:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = CursorTargetRef}}} =
 1470:         peer:call(
 1471:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1472:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, accept, Peer], 60000),
 1473:     ?assertEqual(
 1474:        CursorTargetRef,
 1475:        completed_remote_operation(
 1476:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, CursorEvidence), 600)),
 1477:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_choice, meat),
 1478: 
 1479:     {StopBytes, StopSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1480:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1481:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1482:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor,
 1483:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1484:     {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, StopCursor, _, _}}} =
 1485:         peer:call(
 1486:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1487:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), StopBytes,
 1488:            StopSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1489:     ?assertMatch(
 1490:        {ok, _, {normalized, stopped}},
 1491:        peer:call(
 1492:          Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1493:          [maps:get(session_id, Session), StopCursor, stop, Peer], 60000)).
 1494: 
 1495: %% B contributes only a certified read. C remains the sole writer, so this is
 1496: %% one ordinary remote operation claim and target transaction, never a DTX
 1497: %% group with an empty source Vote/Resolve role for B.
 1498: remote_signed_read_certified_write(Config) ->
 1499:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1500:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1501:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1502:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1503:                  io_lib:format(
 1504:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), "
 1505:                    "\"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1506:     {ok, Evidence,
 1507:      {normalized,
 1508:       {committed, [_],
 1509:        {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, _} = TargetRef}}} =
 1510:         submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText),
 1511:     ?assertEqual(
 1512:        ThirdAnchor,
 1513:        peer:call(Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS])),
 1514:     ?assertEqual(
 1515:        TargetRef,
 1516:        completed_remote_operation(
 1517:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1518:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1519: 
 1520: %% R4-UNCERTAIN-CLAIM-DELIVERY-01: this is a real signed operation admitted
 1521: %% through the ordinary client, source consensus, and remote target. Once it
 1522: %% is accepted, deliver the SAME durable claim twice more through the real
 1523: %% endpoint. Only the transport correlation id changes. No hand-built claim,
 1524: %% new signed goal, new application identity, or admission bypass is used.
 1525: remote_exact_claim_redelivery(Config) ->
 1526:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1527:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1528:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1529:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1530:              "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1531:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_],
 1532:         {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, Anchor, TxId} = TargetRef}}} =
 1533:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1534:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1535:     ?assertEqual(TargetRef, completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600)),
 1536:     {ok, #{height := ClaimSlot}} = peer:call(
 1537:         Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, OperationRef]),
 1538:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1539:     {ok, CertifiedClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(
 1540:         Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1541:         [?ASKER_NS, ClaimSlot, OperationRef, Deadline]),
 1542:     {ok, ClaimBytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim),
 1543:     Target = {?THIRD_NS, Anchor},
 1544:     StableClaimRef = quod_transaction:stable_ref(CertifiedClaimRef),
 1545:     ?assertMatch(#transaction{tx_id = TxId},
 1546:         quod_transaction:remote_application(StableClaimRef, Claim, Target)),
 1547:     Before = peer:call(Third, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences,
 1548:                        [?THIRD_NS, TxId]),
 1549:     ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1550:     lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1551:         ?assertEqual({ok, ClaimBytes},
 1552:                      quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim)),
 1553:         RequestId = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 1554:         Request = {apply_claim, RequestId, Target, ClaimBytes},
 1555:         {ok, {application, RequestId, committed, ApplicationBytes} = Response,
 1556:          _Hints} =
 1557:             peer:call(Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1558:                       [?ASKER_NS, Target, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000),
 1559:         ?assert(quod_dtx_endpoint:correlates(Request, Response)),
 1560:         {ok, ApplicationRef, #transaction{tx_id = TxId,
 1561:             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}}} =
 1562:             quod_transaction:decode_evidence(ApplicationBytes),
 1563:         ?assertEqual(TargetRef, quod_transaction:stable_ref(ApplicationRef)),
 1564:         ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Third, ?MODULE,
 1565:             claim_application_occurrences, [?THIRD_NS, TxId])),
 1566:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag)
 1567:     end, [first_redelivery, second_redelivery]).
 1568: 
 1569: %% Test-side audit only, executed ON the target. An ordinary immutable owner
 1570: %% snapshot is read without returning any store or interpreter state to the
 1571: %% caller. Count ledger occurrences as well as visible facts: an extra inert
 1572: %% or rejected envelope must not hide a second application under the same id.
 1573: claim_application_occurrences(Ns, TxId) ->
 1574:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1575:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1576:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1577:     try
 1578:         lists:reverse(quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1579:             fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1580:                 case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1581:                     #entry{index = Slot, data = {batch, Transactions}} ->
 1582:                         [Slot || #transaction{tx_id = Id,
 1583:                             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}} <- Transactions,
 1584:                             Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1585:                     _ -> Acc
 1586:                 end
 1587:             end, []))
 1588:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1589:     end.
 1590: 
 1591: %% A writes locally while B contributes only a certified read. The result is
 1592: %% A's ordinary transaction; there is no source claim and no DTX group.
 1593: local_write_with_foreign_read(Config) ->
 1594:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1595:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1596:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1597:                  io_lib:format(
 1598:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1599:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1600:     ?assertMatch(
 1601:        {ok, _,
 1602:         {normalized,
 1603:          {committed, [_], {transaction, ?ASKER_NS, _, _}}}},
 1604:        submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)),
 1605:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1606: 
 1607: %% The read token is sealed first. B then commits another diet/2 fact before
 1608: %% its validators sign the certificate. Certification must reject the stale
 1609: %% token and A's local write must remain absent.
 1610: read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1611:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1612:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1613:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1614:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1615:                  io_lib:format(
 1616:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1617:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1618:     ok = peer:call(
 1619:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1620:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1621:     Parent = self(),
 1622:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1623:     _ = spawn(
 1624:           fun() ->
 1625:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1626:           end),
 1627:     try
 1628:         ok = peer:call(
 1629:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1630:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1631:         ?assertMatch(
 1632:            {ok, [_], _},
 1633:            peer:call(
 1634:              Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1635:              [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {stale_marker, Tag}}}],
 1636:              60000))
 1637:     after
 1638:         %% Never leave the TEST-only rendezvous installed if an assertion
 1639:         %% above fails: a later proof would otherwise correctly wait forever.
 1640:         _ = peer:call(
 1641:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1642:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1643:     end,
 1644:     Result = receive
 1645:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1646:              after 60000 ->
 1647:                  ct:fail(stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1648:              end,
 1649:     ?assertMatch(
 1650:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1651:     assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1652: 
 1653: %% The signed claim lane treats A's own read exactly like any other read-only
 1654: %% dependency. If A changes after sealing but before certification, neither the
 1655: %% source claim nor C's write may be submitted.
 1656: remote_signed_origin_read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1657:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1658:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1659:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1660:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1661:                  io_lib:format(
 1662:                    "instance_of(pet, my_dog), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).",
 1663:                    [Tag])),
 1664:     ok = peer:call(
 1665:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1666:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1667:     Parent = self(),
 1668:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1669:     _ = spawn(
 1670:           fun() ->
 1671:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1672:           end),
 1673:     try
 1674:         ok = peer:call(
 1675:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1676:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1677:         %% The source proof is deliberately parked before its certificate.
 1678:         %% Commit the intervening source-head change at the consensus seam so
 1679:         %% this test does not depend on a second client ingress being admitted
 1680:         %% while the first signed request still owns that ingress session.
 1681:         append_source_marker(Config, Tag)
 1682:     after
 1683:         _ = peer:call(
 1684:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1685:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1686:     end,
 1687:     Result = receive
 1688:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1689:              after 60000 ->
 1690:                  ct:fail(origin_stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1691:              end,
 1692:     ?assertMatch(
 1693:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1694:     assert_fact_absent(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1695: 
 1696: %% Two independent gateways race the same signed execute. One may receive a
 1697: %% typed pre-custody availability refusal while the other proof is sealing;
 1698: %% the stable operation claim must still give both gateways one durable result
 1699: %% and one material write.
 1700: remote_signed_two_gateway_race(Config) ->
 1701:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1702:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1703:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1704:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1705:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1706:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1707:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1708:     AskerSession = open_client_session(
 1709:                      Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1710:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1711:     ThirdSession = open_client_session(
 1712:                      Third, NetworkId, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1713:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1714:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1715:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1716:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1717:                  io_lib:format(
 1718:                    "\"animals\"::assertz(gateway_race_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1719:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, AskerSession),
 1720:                   maps:get(expires_ms, ThirdSession)),
 1721:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1722:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1723:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1724:                                   Expires, execute, GoalText),
 1725:     Parent = self(),
 1726:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1727:     _ = spawn(
 1728:           fun() ->
 1729:               Parent !
 1730:                 {RaceRef, asker,
 1731:                  peer:call(
 1732:                    Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1733:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession),
 1734:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1735:           end),
 1736:     _ = spawn(
 1737:           fun() ->
 1738:               Parent !
 1739:                 {RaceRef, third,
 1740:                  peer:call(
 1741:                    Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1742:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession),
 1743:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1744:           end),
 1745:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1746:     Classified = [classify_race_submit(Result)
 1747:                   || {_Gateway, Result} <- Results],
 1748:     Evidences = [Ev || {accepted, Ev} <- Classified],
 1749:     %% A simultaneous second proof may be refused before durable custody while
 1750:     %% the first proof is still sealing. That refusal is safe because both
 1751:     %% gateways retain the exact same signed request and operation reference;
 1752:     %% after the first claim commits, either gateway must resolve it.
 1753:     ?assert(Evidences =/= []),
 1754:     [Evidence | _] = Evidences,
 1755:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1756:     lists:foreach(
 1757:       fun(Ev) ->
 1758:           ?assertEqual(OperationRef, maps:get(operation_ref, Ev)),
 1759:           ?assertEqual(RequestBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, Ev)),
 1760:           ?assertEqual(Signature, maps:get(signature, Ev))
 1761:       end, Evidences),
 1762:     OutcomeRef = {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} =
 1763:         completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1764:     ?assertEqual(
 1765:        TargetAnchor,
 1766:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS])),
 1767:     ?assertMatch(
 1768:        {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 1769:               outcome_ref := {applications, [{transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _}]}}},
 1770:        peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
 1771:     ?assertMatch(
 1772:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1773:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1774:                 #{status := completed,
 1775:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1776:        wait_remote_operation(
 1777:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession), RequestBytes,
 1778:          Signature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 1779:     {ok, #{status := committed, height := OutcomeHeight, ref := OutcomeRef}} =
 1780:         peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]),
 1781:     %% Third is an observer of the target ontology. A remote result at Asker
 1782:     %% does not mean Third's local projection has consumed the target block.
 1783:     %% Wait for that actual event; do not resubmit, nudge the feed, or replace
 1784:     %% the fixture's ordering requirement with a short repeated resolve loop.
 1785:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_ct, await_applied,
 1786:                    [?NS, OutcomeHeight, 10000], 15000),
 1787:     ?assertMatch(
 1788:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1789:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1790:                 #{status := completed,
 1791:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1792:        peer:call(
 1793:          Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1794:          [maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession), RequestBytes,
 1795:           Signature, ClientPeer], 10000)),
 1796:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_race_mark, Tag).
 1797: 
 1798: %% A signed agent stored in A reaches B and then C through the same nested
 1799: %% scope and group machinery. No specialized client or agent executor exists.
 1800: %% Real signed proofs use the same action evaluator locally at animals, on
 1801: %% its co-hosted fourth namespace, and remotely at third. The first candidate
 1802: %% crosses both boundaries, stages facts/events, cuts and fails. Only the
 1803: %% complete second candidate may reach any target ledger.
 1804: independent_action_multiscope_rollback(Config) ->
 1805:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1806:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1807:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1808:       "animals::(assertz((action_bad(~B) :- "
 1809:       "assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B)), "
 1810:       "fourth::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), "
 1811:       "third::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), !, fail)), "
 1812:       "assertz((action_good(~B) :- assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B)), "
 1813:       "fourth::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))), "
 1814:       "third::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))))), "
 1815:       "assertz(action(action_bad(~B), [], action_done(~B))), "
 1816:       "assertz(action(action_good(~B), [], action_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(18, Tag))),
 1817:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1818:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1819:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, Rows}}}} =
 1820:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1821:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1822:     ?assertEqual([?NS, ?FOURTH_NS, ?THIRD_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1823:     Owners = #{?NS => ?config(target, Config), ?FOURTH_NS => ?config(target, Config),
 1824:                ?THIRD_NS => ?config(third, Config)},
 1825:     lists:foreach(fun({{Ns, _}, {committed, {transaction, Ns, _, Id}}}) ->
 1826:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1827:         assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, action_done, Tag),
 1828:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_leak, Tag),
 1829:         Changes = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, action_application_changes, [Ns, Id]),
 1830:         ?assertEqual([{action_done, Tag}], [E || {event, E} <- Changes])
 1831:     end, Rows).
 1832: 
 1833: independent_action_remote_errors(Config) ->
 1834:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1835:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1836:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1837:       "animals::(assertz((action_error(~B) :- assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), "
 1838:       "third::(assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), assertz(true)))), "
 1839:       "assertz(action(action_error(~B), [], action_error_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(5, Tag))),
 1840:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1841:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_error_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1842:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1843:     Capture = peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, start_action_error_capture, []),
 1844:     {Result, Errors} = try
 1845:         {submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1846:          peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture])}
 1847:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
 1848:         peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture]),
 1849:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
 1850:     end,
 1851:     %% Public normalization deliberately hides language descriptors. Pin the
 1852:     %% original error at the real worker return, then the unchanged public form.
 1853:     ?assert(lists:member({permission_error, modify, static_procedure, {'/', true, 0}}, Errors)),
 1854:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, proof_unavailable}}}, Result),
 1855:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 1856:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_error_leak, Tag)
 1857:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
 1858: 
 1859: start_action_error_capture() ->
 1860:     Pid = spawn(fun() -> action_error_capture([], none) end),
 1861:     1 = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, [{'_', [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
 1862:     _ = erlang:trace(all, true, [call, {tracer, Pid}]),
 1863:     Pid.
 1864: 
 1865: finish_action_error_capture(Pid) ->
 1866:     _ = erlang:trace(all, false, [call]),
 1867:     _ = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, false, [local]),
 1868:     Ref = make_ref(), Pid ! {finish, self(), Ref},
 1869:     receive {Ref, Errors} -> Errors after 5000 -> erlang:error(action_trace_timeout) end.
 1870: 
 1871: action_error_capture(Errors, Closing) ->
 1872:     receive
 1873:         {trace, _, return_from, {quod_proof_scope, next, 1},
 1874:          {error, {erlog, Reason}, _, _}} ->
 1875:             true = length(Errors) < 16,
 1876:             action_error_capture([Reason | Errors], Closing);
 1877:         {finish, Caller, Ref} ->
 1878:             Delivery = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
 1879:             action_error_capture(Errors, {Caller, Ref, Delivery});
 1880:         {trace_delivered, all, Delivery} ->
 1881:             {Caller, Ref, Delivery} = Closing, Caller ! {Ref, Errors};
 1882:         _ -> action_error_capture(Errors, Closing)
 1883:     end.
 1884: 
 1885: action_application_changes(Ns, TxId) ->
 1886:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1887:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1888:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1889:     try
 1890:         [Changes] = quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1891:           fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1892:               case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1893:                   #entry{data = {batch, Txs}} ->
 1894:                       [Diff || #transaction{tx_id = Id, diff = Diff} <- Txs,
 1895:                                Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1896:                   _ -> Acc
 1897:               end
 1898:           end, []),
 1899:         Changes
 1900:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1901:     end.
 1902: 
 1903: %% Root's governed create_ontology bridge uses the same action evaluator and
 1904: %% its private savepoint. The other target writes ordinary facts; Root remains
 1905: %% effect-only, and exact durable claim redelivery cannot repeat the effect.
 1906: independent_action_remote_prepared_rollback(Config) ->
 1907:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1908:     Discarded = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-discarded-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1909:     Kept = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-kept-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1910:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1911:       "(assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1912:       "assertz((action_effect_bad(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), !, fail)), "
 1913:       "assertz((action_effect_good(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), assertz(action_effect_done(~B)))), "
 1914:       "assertz(action(action_effect_bad(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B))), "
 1915:       "assertz(action(action_effect_good(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B)))).",
 1916:       [Tag, Tag, Discarded, Tag, Kept, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag])),
 1917:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1918:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("independent(goal(action_effect_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1919:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1920:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1921:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1922:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1923:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1924:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])),
 1925:     ?assertEqual({ok, ready}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Kept])),
 1926:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, action_effect_done, Tag),
 1927:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1928:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])).

 1930: remote_independent_root_effect(Config) ->
 1931:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1932:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1933:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:s8-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1934:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1935:       "independent((assertz(s8_effect_mark(~B)), "
 1936:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 1937:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 1938:       "s8_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor))).", [Tag, CreatedNs])),
 1939:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1940:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1941:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1942:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1943:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1944:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1945:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {s8_effect_created, ok}),
 1946:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs]),
 1947:     ?assertMatch(<<_:256>>, Anchor),
 1948:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1949:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs])),
 1950:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1951:     #{included := Receipt} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ct, await_operation_complete,
 1952:                                       [?ASKER_NS, Op, 5000], 10000),
 1953:     ?assert(quod_operation_vector:certified(Receipt)).

 1955: remote_independent_routes(Config) ->
 1956:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1957:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1958:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
 1959:       submit_signed_execute(Config, <<"animals::independent(true).">>)),
 1960:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1961:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1962:       "animals::independent(assertz(s6_remote(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1963:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], Ref}}} =
 1964:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1965:     ?assertMatch({transaction, ?NS, _, _}, Ref),
 1966:     ?assertEqual(Ref, completed_remote_operation(
 1967:                        Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1968:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, s6_remote, Tag),
 1969:     lists:foreach(fun(Goal) ->
 1970:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1971:                      submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal))
 1972:     end, [<<"independent((assertz(s6_ab), animals::assertz(s6_ab))).">>,
 1973:           <<"animals::independent((assertz(s6_bc), third::assertz(s6_bc))).">>]),
 1974:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns, Fact}) ->
 1975:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Fact]))
 1976:     end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s6_ab}, {Target, ?NS, s6_ab},
 1977:           {Target, ?NS, s6_bc}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_bc}]).

 1979: %% L2-S8-DEFERRED-7.4-ADMITTED-PARTIAL-OUTCOME: both plans are genuinely
 1980: %% sealed, then one target's read becomes stale before claim admission. The
 1981: %% shared applier rejects ONLY that target. No hand-built claim or bypass.
 1982: remote_independent_partial_outcome(Config) ->
 1983:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1984:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1985:     Third = ?config(third, Config), Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1986:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1987:       "animals::independent((diet(dog, kibble), assertz(s8_rejected(~B)), third::dtx_write(~B))).",
 1988:       [Tag, Tag])),
 1989:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1990:     Parent = self(), RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1991:     _ = spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal)} end),
 1992:     try
 1993:         ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1994:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1995:           [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {s8_stale_marker, Tag}}}], 60000))
 1996:     after
 1997:         _ = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1998:     end,
 1999:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 2000:         receive {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 2001:         after 60000 -> ct:fail(independent_partial_outcome_timeout) end,
 2002:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 2003:     ?assertEqual(mixed, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 2004:     ?assertMatch([{{?NS, _}, {{rejected, conflict_retry}, _}},
 2005:                   {{?THIRD_NS, _}, {committed, _}}], Rows),
 2006:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 2007:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2008:     %% Repeat exact delivery after mixed completion: rejected A stays rejected,
 2009:     %% committed B stays exactly once, and neither gets a fresh application id.
 2010:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?NS => Target, ?THIRD_NS => Third}),
 2011:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 2012:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2013:     %% The source owner must recover the same complete vector for a later
 2014:     %% caller. A different gateway then verifies the source receipt and the
 2015:     %% exact AM3 target evidence; current-view status labels are insufficient.
 2016:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, ?config(client_session, Config)),
 2017:     RequestBytes = maps:get(request_bytes, Evidence), Signature = maps:get(signature, Evidence),
 2018:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 2019:       peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 2020:         [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 10000)),
 2021:     ForeignSession = open_client_session(Target, ?config(network_id, Config),
 2022:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config), ?config(client_peer, Config)),
 2023:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 2024:       wait_remote_operation(Target, maps:get(session_id, ForeignSession), RequestBytes,
 2025:         Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config), 8)).

 2028: assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, Owners) ->
 2029:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2030:     {ok, #{height := Slot}} = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, Op]),
 2031:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 2032:     {ok, ClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 2033:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Slot, Op, Deadline]),
 2034:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim),
 2035:     lists:foreach(fun({Identity = {Ns, _}, {Verdict, Ref}}) ->
 2036:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 2037:         {transaction, _, _, TxId} = Ref,
 2038:         Before = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]),
 2039:         ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 2040:         lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 2041:             ?assertEqual({ok, Bytes}, quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim)),
 2042:             Id = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), Request = {apply_claim, Id, Identity, Bytes},
 2043:             ?assertMatch({ok, {application, Id, Verdict, _}, _Hints}, peer:call(
 2044:               Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 2045:               [?ASKER_NS, Identity, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000)),
 2046:             ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]))
 2047:         end, [first, second])
 2048:     end, Rows).

 2050: %% Positive atomic/reconnect cases establish their own route precondition. A prior
 2051: %% case may already have installed this exact fixture route; verify it then,
 2052: %% never erase it or rely on a particular suite order. Negative/recovery
 2053: %% route cases use the separately isolated read-set suite.
 2054: require_third_route_at_target(Config) ->
 2055:     Peer = ?config(target, Config), Key = ?config(third_pub, Config),
 2056:     Endpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
 2057:     Identity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 2058:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]) of
 2059:         {error, unavailable} ->
 2060:             {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2061:               [Key, Endpoint, [{?THIRD_NS, element(2, Identity), validator}], 1, 1]);
 2062:         {ok, _} -> ok
 2063:     end,
 2064:     {ok, Routes} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]),
 2065:     {Key, Endpoints} = lists:keyfind(Key, 1, Routes),
 2066:     ?assert(lists:member(Endpoint, Endpoints)),
 2067:     ok.

 2069: remote_independent_branch_provenance(Config) ->
 2070:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2071:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2072:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2073:     %% The original signed request and real sealed retained writes choose L3.
 2074:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 2075:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2076:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f1), third::assertz(s6_f1), fail))); true).">>)),
 2077:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 2078:                  peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f1])),
 2079:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f1])),
 2080:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, independent_mixed_writes}}},
 2081:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2082:         <<"animals::(((assertz(s6_f2), fail); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f2))).">>)),
 2083:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 2084:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2085:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f3), fail)); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f3))).">>)),
 2086:     %% A remotely-produced successful marker must unwind at its caller too.
 2087:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 2088:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 2089:         <<"((animals::independent((assertz(s6_unwound), third::assertz(s6_unwound))), fail); true).">>)),
 2090:     lists:foreach(fun(Fact) ->
 2091:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Fact])),
 2092:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, Fact]))
 2093:     end, [s6_f2]),
 2094:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f3])),
 2095:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f3])).

 2116: remote_independent_cursor_selects_only_accepted_answer(Config) ->
 2117:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2118:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2119:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2120:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2121:     lists:foreach(fun(AcceptSecond) ->
 2122:         Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2123:         Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 2124:           "animals::((independent((assertz(s6_cursor(~B)), third::assertz(s6_cursor(~B)))), X=first); X=second).",
 2125:           [Tag, Tag])),
 2126:         {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2127:           ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2128:           ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor, Text),
 2129:         {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, First}}} = peer:call(
 2130:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2131:           [cursor, SessionId, Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2132:         ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, first}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(First)),
 2133:         case AcceptSecond of
 2134:             false -> ok;
 2135:             true ->
 2136:                 {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, Second}}} = peer:call(
 2137:                   Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 2138:                   [SessionId, CursorId, next, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2139:                 ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, second}]},
 2140:                              quod_durable_term:decode_result(Second))
 2141:         end,
 2142:         Result = peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 2143:                           [SessionId, CursorId, accept, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2144:         case AcceptSecond of
 2145:             false ->
 2146:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 2147:                              {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}}, Result),
 2148:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 2149:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag);
 2150:             true ->
 2151:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 2152:                                      {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}}, Result),
 2153:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 2154:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag)
 2155:         end
 2156:     end, [false, true]).
