 2158: remote_signed_gateway_group(Config) ->
 2159:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2160:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2161:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2162:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2163:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2164:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2165:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2166:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2167: 
 2168:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2169:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2170:     %% Third already received Target's exact current record in suite setup.
 2171:     %% Reinstalling sequence 1 here would correctly be rejected as stale.
 2172:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2173:     GroupText = iolist_to_binary(
 2174:                   io_lib:format(
 2175:                     "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).", [Tag])),
 2176:     {GroupBytes, GroupSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 2177:                                      NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2178:                                      ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2179:                                      maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2180:                                      GroupText),
 2181:     {ok, GroupEvidence,
 2182:      {normalized,
 2183:       {committed, [_],
 2184:        {group_outcome,
 2185:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2186:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2187:         peer:call(
 2188:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2189:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), GroupBytes,
 2190:            GroupSignature, Peer], 60000),
 2191:     %% O participates even when both writable scopes are remote.
 2192:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2193:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2194:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2195:     ?assertMatch(
 2196:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2197:        peer:call(
 2198:          Asker, quod_prolog, outcome,
 2199:          [maps:get(operation_ref, GroupEvidence)])),
 2200:     ok.
 2201: 
 2202: %% Eight independently signed, non-conflicting A -> B -> C writes enter
 2203: %% together. Each writes distinct predicate heads on B and C, so this exercises
 2204: %% the conflict-safe batch path rather than the separate wait-die abort test
 2205: %% below. The old single handoff slot rejected this shape as busy.
 2206: remote_signed_concurrent_gateway_groups(Config) ->
 2207:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2208:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2209:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2210:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2211:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2212:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2213:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2214:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2215:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2216:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2217:     PredicateRows = dtx_disjoint_predicates(),
 2218:     Requests =
 2219:         [begin
 2220:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2221:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2222:                           io_lib:format(
 2223:                             "\"animals\"::~s(~B).",
 2224:                             [atom_to_list(ChainPredicate), Tag])),
 2225:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2226:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2227:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2228:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 2229:                                            execute, GoalText),
 2230:              {Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 2231:               RequestBytes, Signature}
 2232:          end || {Index, {ChainPredicate, LocalPredicate,
 2233:                          _RemoteWriter, RemotePredicate}} <-
 2234:                     lists:zip(lists:seq(1, 8), PredicateRows)],
 2235:     Parent = self(),
 2236:     ConcurrentRef = make_ref(),
 2237:     Writers =
 2238:         [spawn(
 2239:            fun() ->
 2240:                receive {ConcurrentRef, go} -> ok end,
 2241:                Result = peer:call(
 2242:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2243:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2244:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2245:                Parent ! {ConcurrentRef, Index, Result}
 2246:            end)
 2247:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 2248:              RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2249:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {ConcurrentRef, go} end, Writers),
 2250:     Results = collect_gateway_race(ConcurrentRef, length(Requests), []),
 2251:     EvidenceByIndex =
 2252:         maps:from_list(
 2253:           [{Index, concurrent_submit_evidence(Index, Result)}
 2254:            || {Index, Result} <- Results]),
 2255:     OperationRefs =
 2256:         [maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex))
 2257:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 2258:              _RequestBytes, _Signature} <- Requests],
 2259:     ?assertEqual(length(Requests), length(lists:usort(OperationRefs))),
 2260:     lists:foreach(
 2261:       fun({Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 2262:            _RequestBytes, _Signature}) ->
 2263:           OperationRef = maps:get(
 2264:                            operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex)),
 2265:           {#{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef},
 2266:            #{status := committed, participant_slots := Slots}} =
 2267:               wait_operation_claim(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 2268:           ?assertMatch(
 2269:              {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _}, GroupRef),
 2270:           ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2271:           assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, LocalPredicate, Tag),
 2272:           assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, RemotePredicate, Tag)
 2273:       end, Requests),
 2274:     Stats = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2275:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_waiting, Stats)),
 2276:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_dormant, Stats)),
 2277:     ok.
 2278: 
 2279: %% Both proofs read conflict_version/1 while it is zero, then wait at the
 2280: %% pre-Vote FIFO seam. One group changes that fact; the other must retain its
 2281: %% claimed operation id and terminate with the ordinary stale-read abort.
 2282: remote_signed_queued_occ_abort(Config) ->
 2283:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2284:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2285:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2286:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2287:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2288:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2289:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2290:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2291:     Session = open_client_session(
 2292:                 Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 2293:                 AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 2294:     Requests =
 2295:         [begin
 2296:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2297:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2298:                           io_lib:format(
 2299:                             "\"animals\"::dtx_conflicting_write(~B).",
 2300:                             [Tag])),
 2301:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2302:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2303:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2304:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 2305:                                            execute, GoalText),
 2306:              {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature}
 2307:          end || Index <- [1, 2]],
 2308:     Parent = self(),
 2309:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 2310:     Writers =
 2311:         [spawn(
 2312:            fun() ->
 2313:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 2314:                Result = peer:call(
 2315:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2316:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2317:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2318:                Parent ! {RaceRef, Index, Result}
 2319:            end)
 2320:          || {Index, _Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2321:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {RaceRef, go} end, Writers),
 2322:     Evidences = maps:from_list(
 2323:                   [{Index, concurrent_conflict_evidence(Index, Result)}
 2324:                    || {Index, Result} <-
 2325:                           collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, [])]),
 2326:     Outcomes =
 2327:         [{Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2328:           wait_operation_terminal(
 2329:             Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, Evidences)), 600)}
 2330:          || {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2331:     [{CommittedIndex, CommittedTag, _CommittedBytes, _CommittedSignature,
 2332:       {_, #{status := committed}}}] =
 2333:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _, {_, #{status := committed}}} <- Outcomes],
 2334:     [{AbortedIndex, AbortedTag, AbortedBytes, AbortedSignature,
 2335:       {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}}] =
 2336:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _,
 2337:                        {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}} <- Outcomes],
 2338:     ?assertNotEqual(CommittedIndex, AbortedIndex),
 2339:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, CommittedTag),
 2340:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, AbortedTag),
 2341:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, CommittedTag),
 2342:     ?assertMatch(
 2343:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 2344:                 #{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}},
 2345:        wait_remote_operation(
 2346:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, Session), AbortedBytes,
 2347:          AbortedSignature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 2348:     ok.
 2349: 
 2350: %% One signed proof writes its agent ontology and stages Root's existing
 2351: %% create-ontology effect.  Root is hosted on another peer, so this exercises
 2352: %% the real scope custody command, not only the co-hosted session path.
 2353: remote_signed_gateway_group_with_root_effect(Config) ->
 2354:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2355:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2356:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2357:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2358:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2359:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2360:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2361:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2362:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2363:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(
 2364:                   ["ct:remote-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2365:     GoalText = root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs),
 2366:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2367:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2368:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2369:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2370:                                   GoalText),
 2371:     {ok, _Evidence,
 2372:      {normalized,
 2373:       {committed, [_],
 2374:        {group_outcome,
 2375:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2376:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2377:         peer:call(
 2378:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2379:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), RequestBytes,
 2380:            Signature, Peer], 60000),
 2381:     ?assertEqual(2, length(Slots)),
 2382:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2383:     %% Group application records the effect obligation; the existing effect
 2384:     %% owner starts the ontology asynchronously. Observe its completion before
 2385:     %% asking the new ontology to prove a goal.
 2386:     wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, applied, 300),
 2387:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {remote_effect_created, ok}),
 2388:     ok.
 2389: 
 2390: root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs) ->
 2391:     iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 2392:       "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2393:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 2394:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 2395:       "remote_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor).", [Tag, CreatedNs])).
 2396: 
 2397: %% A real remote effect is durably bound, but the source never activates.
 2398: %% OTP's installed debug callback holds the existing activation call before
 2399: %% handle_call, without a production hook or a send/receipt ordering guess.
 2400: remote_bound_effect_recovers_without_activation(Config) ->
 2401:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2402:     OldEngine = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2403:     OldSimplex = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2404:     Gate = {?MODULE, before_activation},
 2405:     ok = peer:call(Asker, sys, install,
 2406:                    [OldEngine, {Gate, fun ?MODULE:hold_group_activation/3, armed}]),
 2407:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2408:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:aborted-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2409:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2410:     %% Choose the request's original bound once; never extend it after failure.
 2411:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, Session), quod_time:now_ms() + 10000),
 2412:     {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2413:       ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2414:       ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), Expires, execute,
 2415:       root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs)),
 2416:     Parent = self(), CallRef = make_ref(), ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2417:     spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {CallRef, peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2418:       submit, [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)} end),
 2419:     try
 2420:         {GroupRef, _Token} = wait_activation_gate(Asker, CallRef, 300),
 2421:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, group_pending, 50),
 2422:         {running, OwnerState} = peer:call(Asker, sys, get_state, [OldSimplex]),
 2423:         ?assertMatch(#{active := 0, reserved := 1}, peer:call(
 2424:           Asker, quod_simplex, test_dtx_admission_state, [OwnerState])),
 2425:         Journal = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, test_signing_journal, [OwnerState]),
 2426:         {group, _, _, _, _, Id} = GroupRef,
 2427:         #{Id := #{sequence := 0, envelope := none,
 2428:                   material := {{quod_dtx_vote, 4, Group, _, none, _}, _, _}}} =
 2429:             peer:call(Asker, quod_signing_journal, pending_dtx, [Journal]),
 2430:         %% Source responsibility already retains the exact original request,
 2431:         %% before activation or any source Vote. It is not just a generated
 2432:         %% operation ID that a later hosted incarnation would have to recreate.
 2433:         Digest = crypto:hash(sha256,Bytes),
 2434:         ?assertMatch({quod_atomic_group,4,_,{agent_goal_v1,Digest,Bytes,Signature},_},Group),
 2435:         {ok,#{request := #{evidence := #{agent_ref_blob := AgentBytes}}}} =
 2436:             peer:call(Asker,quod_atomic,group_binding,[Group]),
 2437:         ?assertEqual(#{Id => true},peer:call(Asker,?MODULE,agent_custody_snapshot,[OldSimplex,AgentBytes])),
 2438:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldEngine, kill]),
 2439:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2440:         receive {CallRef, Result} ->
 2441:             ?assertNotMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
 2442:         after 10000 -> ct:fail(bound_effect_caller_did_not_observe_crash)
 2443:         end,
 2444:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2445:         ?assertMatch(#{status := aborted, ref := GroupRef},
 2446:                      wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600)),
 2447:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, retired, 300),
 2448:         assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2449:         ?assertEqual(undefined, peer:call(Target, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, CreatedNs}])),
 2450:         assert_dtx_released(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2451:         assert_dtx_released(Target, ?ROOT_NS)
 2452:     after
 2453:         %% Release only this test gate if setup failed before the injected kill.
 2454:         case peer:call(Asker, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2455:             {ok, {_Ref, Release}} -> peer:call(Asker, erlang, send, [OldEngine, {release, Release}]);
 2456:             _ -> ok
 2457:         end,
 2458:         _ = catch peer:call(Asker, sys, remove, [OldEngine, Gate]),
 2459:         _ = peer:call(Asker, application, unset_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate])
 2460:     end.
 2461: 
 2462: agent_custody_snapshot(Owner, Agent) ->
 2463:     Token = make_ref(), Monitor = monitor(process,Owner),
 2464:     Owner ! {agent_work_custody,self(),Token,Agent,all},
 2465:     try receive
 2466:         {agent_work_custody,Owner,Token,Rows} -> Rows;
 2467:         {'DOWN',Monitor,process,Owner,Reason} -> error({custody_owner_down,Reason})
 2468:     after 5000 -> error(custody_snapshot_missing)
 2469:     end after demonitor(Monitor,[flush]) end.
 2470: 
 2471: hold_group_activation(armed, {in, {'$gen_call', _, {activate_dtx_vote, _, GroupRef}}}, _) ->
 2472:     Token = make_ref(),
 2473:     ok = application:set_env(quod, ct_activation_gate, {GroupRef, Token}),
 2474:     receive {release, Token} -> ok after 15000 -> ok end,
 2475:     done;
 2476: hold_group_activation(State, _Event, _Name) -> State.
 2477: 
 2478: wait_activation_gate(_Peer, _CallRef, 0) -> ct:fail(activation_gate_timeout);
 2479: wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries) ->
 2480:     case peer:call(Peer, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2481:         {ok, {_, _} = Held} -> Held;
 2482:         _ ->
 2483:             receive {CallRef, Result} -> ct:fail({proof_ended_before_activation, Result})
 2484:             after 20 -> wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries - 1)
 2485:             end
 2486:     end.
 2487: 
 2488: %% One browser-equivalent request crosses two remote scope hops and commits
 2489: %% through the ordinary group protocol.
 2490: remote_signed_group_uses_exact_agent_request(Config) ->
 2491:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2492:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2493:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2494:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2495:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2496:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2497:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2498:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2499:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2500:                  io_lib:format(
 2501:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2502:                    "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).",
 2503:                    [Tag, Tag])),
 2504:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2505:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2506:                                   ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2507:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), GoalText),
 2508:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, SubmitResult}} = peer:call(
 2509:                                                    Asker,
 2510:                                                    quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2511:                                                    submit,
 2512:                                                    [execute,
 2513:                                                     maps:get(session_id,
 2514:                                                              Session),
 2515:                                                     RequestBytes, Signature,
 2516:                                                     Peer],
 2517:                                                    60000),
 2518:     {GroupRef, Outcome} =
 2519:         case SubmitResult of
 2520:             {committed, [_],
 2521:              {group_outcome,
 2522:               {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref,
 2523:               Height, ParticipantSlots}} ->
 2524:                 {Ref, #{status => committed, ref => Ref, height => Height,
 2525:                         participant_slots => ParticipantSlots}};
 2526:             {pending, {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref} ->
 2527:                 %% A transport timeout is uncertainty, never permission to
 2528:                 %% resubmit. Resolve the exact first group instead.
 2529:                 {Ref, wait_group_outcome(Asker, Ref, 600)}
 2530:         end,
 2531:     Slots = maps:get(participant_slots, Outcome),
 2532:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2533:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2534:     assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2535:     assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2536:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 2537:     ?assertMatch(
 2538:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2539:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])).
 2540: 
 2541: %% The origin is stopped after the remote Vote wave, before any Resolve.
 2542: %% Recovery uses certified own-role material, never a re-proof or another
 2543: %% role's plan. The exact caller reference still finds the one terminal result.
 2544: remote_group_recovers_after_origin_crash(Config) ->
 2545:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2546:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2547:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2548:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2549:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2550:     Goal = {',', {assertz, {dtx_pets_mark, Tag}},
 2551:                  {'::', ?NS, {dtx_write_chain, Tag}}},
 2552:     VotePhase = {voted, {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)}},
 2553:     ok = peer:call(
 2554:            Asker, application, set_env,
 2555:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier, {hold, VotePhase}]),
 2556:     ?assertEqual(
 2557:        {ok, {hold, VotePhase}},
 2558:        peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2559:                  [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2560:     Parent = self(),
 2561:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2562:     _ProofCaller = spawn(
 2563:                      fun() ->
 2564:                          Result = peer:call(
 2565:                                     Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 2566:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000),
 2567:                          Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2568:                      end),
 2569:     try
 2570:         GroupId = wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, VotePhase, Config),
 2571:         %% No role has applied; each one's exact positive Vote must already
 2572:         %% be certified, making commit the only possible recovered outcome.
 2573:         lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 2574:             assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId),
 2575:             assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId)
 2576:         end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]),
 2577:         {ok, {?ASKER_NS, Anchor, Coordinator, Admission}} =
 2578:             peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, dtx_binding, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2579:         GroupRef = {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2580:                     Coordinator, Admission, GroupId},
 2581:         OldSimplex = peer:call(
 2582:                        Asker, quod_reg, where,
 2583:                        [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2584:         true = is_pid(OldSimplex),
 2585:         %% The bounded test valve must still be holding the coordinator at
 2586:         %% the Vote wave. Otherwise a slow test could silently crash after a
 2587:         %% self-released gate and prove only a weaker recovery path.
 2588:         ?assertMatch(
 2589:            {ok, {held, GroupId, VotePhase, _}},
 2590:            peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2591:                      [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2592:         %% Disable the one-shot barrier before restart: the replacement
 2593:         %% coordinator must be free to rediscover the Votes and continue.
 2594:         ok = peer:call(
 2595:                Asker, application, unset_env,
 2596:                [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]),
 2597:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2598:         ?assertEqual(
 2599:            {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}},
 2600:            receive
 2601:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2602:            after 10000 ->
 2603:                ct:fail(proof_caller_did_not_observe_origin_crash)
 2604:            end),
 2605:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2606:         Outcome = wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600),
 2607:         ?assertMatch(
 2608:            #{status := committed, ref := GroupRef,
 2609:              participant_slots := [_, _, _]}, Outcome),
 2610:         assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, dtx_pets_mark, Tag),
 2611:         assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2612:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2613:         lists:foreach(
 2614:           fun({Peer, Ns}) -> assert_dtx_released(Peer, Ns) end,
 2615:           [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}])
 2616:     after
 2617:         _ = peer:call(
 2618:               Asker, application, unset_env,
 2619:               [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])
 2620:     end.
 2621: 
 2622: %% A route consumer knows the certified identities but starts with no live
 2623: %% route rows.  Each missing hop parks on the one exact directory property;
 2624: %% installing the ordinary complete generation wakes that same proof.  Four
 2625: %% ontology scopes are involved even though B and D share one physical node.
 2626: remote_four_scope_chain_recovers_empty_routes(Config) ->
 2627:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2628:     TargetIdentity = {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)},
 2629:     ThirdIdentity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 2630:     Before = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2631:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, expire, [1 bsl 60]),
 2632:     ?assertEqual(
 2633:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS])),
 2634:     ?assertEqual(
 2635:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?THIRD_NS])),
 2636:     Parent = self(),
 2637:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2638:     _Caller = spawn(
 2639:                 fun() ->
 2640:                     Result = peer:call(
 2641:                                Asker, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 2642:                                [?ASKER_NS,
 2643:                                 {'::', ?NS, {via_fourth, {'X'}}}],
 2644:                                60000),
 2645:                     Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2646:                 end),
 2647:     try
 2648:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, TargetIdentity, 500),
 2649:         ok = install_chain_target_generation(Config),
 2650:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, ThirdIdentity, 500),
 2651:         ok = install_chain_third_generation(Config),
 2652:         ?assertMatch(
 2653:            {ok, [#{'X' := _}], _},
 2654:            receive
 2655:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2656:            after 10000 ->
 2657:                ct:fail(four_scope_route_wake_timeout)
 2658:            end),
 2659:         After = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2660:         ?assert(maps:get(route_demanded, After) >=
 2661:                     maps:get(route_demanded, Before) + 2),
 2662:         ?assert(maps:get(route_wakes, After) >=
 2663:                     maps:get(route_wakes, Before) + 2)
 2664:     after
 2665:         %% Restore complete generations even if the assertion failed so this
 2666:         %% suite never leaves a hidden route dependency for later cleanup.
 2667:         _ = install_chain_target_generation(Config),
 2668:         _ = install_chain_third_generation(Config)
 2669:     end.
 2670: 
 2671: wait_route_demand(_Peer, Identity, 0) ->
 2672:     ct:fail({route_demand_timeout, Identity});
 2673: wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries) ->
 2674:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []) of
 2675:         #{route_demands := Demands} ->
 2676:             case lists:member(Identity, Demands) of
 2677:                 true -> ok;
 2678:                 false ->
 2679:                     timer:sleep(10),
 2680:                     wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2681:             end;
 2682:         _ ->
 2683:             timer:sleep(10),
 2684:             wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2685:     end.
 2686: 
 2687: install_chain_target_generation(Config) ->
 2688:     enrollment_route(?config(asker, Config),
 2689:         ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 2690:         [{?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), validator},
 2691:          {?FOURTH_NS, ?config(fourth_anchor, Config), validator},
 2692:          {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}]).
 2693: 
 2694: install_chain_third_generation(Config) ->
 2695:     enrollment_route(?config(asker, Config),
 2696:         ?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 2697:         [{?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config), validator},
 2698:          {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), observer}]).
 2699: 
 2700: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config) ->
 2701:     wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, 300).
 2702: 
 2703: wait_vote_barrier(_ProofRef, _Phase, Config, 0) ->
 2704:     ct:fail({dtx_vote_barrier_timeout, dtx_diagnostics(Config)});
 2705: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries) ->
 2706:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2707:     case peer:call(
 2708:            Asker, application, get_env,
 2709:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]) of
 2710:         {ok, {held, <<_:256>> = GroupId, Phase, _BarrierRef}} ->
 2711:             %% The gate is before the next planner drive, not a timed guess.
 2712:             GroupId;
 2713:         _ ->
 2714:             receive
 2715:                 {ProofRef, ProofResult} ->
 2716:                     ct:fail({group_proof_ended_before_vote, ProofResult})
 2717:             after 0 ->
 2718:                 timer:sleep(50),
 2719:                 wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries - 1)
 2720:             end
 2721:     end.
 2722: 
 2723: assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2724:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, vote},
 2725:     {ok, {phase, _, _, {committed, Ref}}, _} = peer:call(
 2726:         Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local, [Ns, Request, [], 1000]),
 2727:     {ok, Identity, _, _} = quod_dtx:certified_ref_binding(Ref),
 2728:     Deadline = peer:call(Peer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 2729:     {ok, #{control := Control}} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log,
 2730:         resolve_reference, [Identity, Ref, vote, none, none, Deadline]),
 2731:     ?assertMatch({quod_dtx_vote, 4, _, _, _, prepared},
 2732:                  quod_atomic:control_body(Control)).
 2733: 
 2734: assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2735:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, resolve},
 2736:     ?assertMatch(
 2737:        {ok, {phase, _, _, not_found}, []},
 2738:        peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2739:                  [Ns, Request, [], 1000])).
 2740: 
 2741: wait_remote_effect_state(_Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, 0) ->
 2742:     ct:fail({effect_state_timeout, Ns, GroupRef, Expected});
 2743: wait_remote_effect_state(Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries) ->
 2744:     Rows = peer:call(Peer, quod_effect_journal, rows, []),
 2745:     case [State || #{target := {RowNs, _}, ref := RowRef,
 2746:                      state := State} <- Rows,
 2747:                    RowNs =:= Ns,
 2748:                    element(1, RowRef) =:= group_effect,
 2749:                    element(3, RowRef) =:= GroupRef] of
 2750:         [Expected] -> ok;
 2751:         _ ->
 2752:             timer:sleep(20),
 2753:             wait_remote_effect_state(
 2754:               Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries - 1)
 2755:     end.
 2756: 
 2757: dtx_diagnostics(Config) ->
 2758:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2759:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2760:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2761:     Statuses =
 2762:         [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])}
 2763:          || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2764:                            {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2765:     GroupId =
 2766:         case proplists:get_value(?ASKER_NS, Statuses, #{}) of
 2767:             #{dtx_coordinators := Coordinators} ->
 2768:                 single_coordinator_id(Coordinators);
 2769:             _ -> undefined
 2770:         end,
 2771:     AskerInternal = dtx_internal_diagnostics(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2772:     Phases =
 2773:         case GroupId of
 2774:             <<_:256>> ->
 2775:                 [{Ns,
 2776:                   [{Kind,
 2777:                     peer:call(
 2778:                       Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2779:                       [Ns, {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 2780:                             GroupId, Kind}, [], 1000])}
 2781:                    || Kind <- [vote, resolve, complete]]}
 2782:                  || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2783:                                    {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]];
 2784:             _ ->
 2785:                 []
 2786:         end,
 2787:     BVote = phase_result(?NS, Phases, vote),
 2788:     CVote = phase_result(?THIRD_NS, Phases, vote),
 2789:     RawBVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2790:                    Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config),
 2791:                    ?config(target_addr, Config), BVote),
 2792:     RawCVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2793:                    Asker, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 2794:                    ?config(third_addr, Config), CVote),
 2795:     #{statuses => Statuses, phases => Phases,
 2796:       asker_internal => AskerInternal,
 2797:       raw_b_vote_verify => RawBVerify,
 2798:       raw_c_vote_verify => RawCVerify,
 2799:       foreign_log_stats =>
 2800:           [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, stats, [])}
 2801:            || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2802:                              {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2803:       asker_routes =>
 2804:           [{Ns, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [Ns])}
 2805:            || Ns <- [?NS, ?THIRD_NS]],
 2806:       third_origin_routes =>
 2807:           peer:call(Third, quod_directory, validator_routes,
 2808:                     [?ASKER_NS,
 2809:                      peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash,
 2810:                                [?ASKER_NS])])}.

 2820: phase_result(Ns, Phases, Kind) ->
 2821:     case lists:keyfind(Ns, 1, Phases) of
 2822:         {Ns, Results} ->
 2823:             case lists:keyfind(Kind, 1, Results) of
 2824:                 {Kind, Result} -> Result;
 2825:                 false -> not_queried
 2826:             end;
 2827:         false -> not_queried

 2830: dtx_internal_diagnostics(Peer, Ns) ->
 2831:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2832:     case peer:call(Peer, sys, get_state, [Simplex]) of
 2833:         {running, State} ->
 2834:             Coordinator = peer:call(
 2835:                             Peer, quod_simplex,
 2836:                             test_dtx_coordinator_state, [State]),
 2837:             Counts = peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex,
 2838:                                test_dtx_endpoint_counts, [State]),
 2839:             #{coordinator => Coordinator,
 2840:               endpoint_counts => Counts};
 2841:         Other ->
 2842:             #{state => Other}
 2843:     end.

 2853: wait_restarted(_Peer, _Ns, _OldSimplex, 0) ->
 2854:     ct:fail(origin_namespace_did_not_restart);
 2855: wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries) ->
 2856:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2857:     Prolog = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, Ns}]),
 2858:     case is_pid(Simplex) andalso Simplex =/= OldSimplex andalso
 2859:          is_pid(Prolog) of
 2860:         true -> ok;
 2861:         false -> timer:sleep(25),
 2862:                  wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries - 1)
 2863:     end.

 2865: wait_group_outcome(_Peer, GroupRef, 0) ->
 2866:     ct:fail({group_outcome_never_became_terminal, GroupRef});
 2867: wait_group_outcome(Peer, {group, Ns, _, _, _, _} = GroupRef, Retries) ->
 2868:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, outcome, [GroupRef]) of
 2869:         {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2870:           when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted -> Outcome;
 2871:         {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2872:             timer:sleep(50),
 2873:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2874:         {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}} ->
 2875:             timer:sleep(50),
 2876:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2877:         {error, {ontology_rebuilding, Ns}} ->
 2878:             timer:sleep(50),
 2879:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2880:         Other ->
 2881:             ct:fail({unexpected_group_outcome, Other})
 2882:     end.

 2964:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, _Bindings, _Outcome}}}) ->

 2966: classify_race_submit(
 2967:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {pending, _PendingRef}}}) ->
 2968:     %% A multi-ontology proof may already be durably represented by its group
 2969:     %% reference.  The signed operation remains the stable public lookup key
 2970:     %% in either case, and is resolved below without resubmitting.

 3008: wait_operation_claim(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 3009:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 3010: wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 3011:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 3012:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 3013:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 3014:                 {ok, #{status := committed} = Outcome} -> {Claim, Outcome};
 3015:                 {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 3016:                     timer:sleep(50),
 3017:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 3018:                 {error, _} ->
 3019:                     timer:sleep(50),
 3020:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 3021:                 Other ->
 3022:                     ct:fail({unexpected_operation_outcome, Other})
 3023:             end;
 3024:         {error, _} ->
 3025:             timer:sleep(50),
 3026:             wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 3027:         Other ->
 3028:             ct:fail({unexpected_operation_claim, Other})
 3029:     end.
 3030: 
 3031: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 3032:     ct:fail(
 3033:       {operation_completion_timeout, OperationRef,
 3034:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS])});
 3035: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 3036:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 3037:         {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 3038:                outcome_ref := {applications, [OutcomeRef]}, included := Included}} ->
 3039:             ?assertMatch([{_, {certified, OutcomeRef, _}}], Included),
 3040:             ?assertEqual({ok, [OutcomeRef]}, quod_operation_vector:receipt_references(Included)),
 3041:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 3042:                 {ok, #{status := committed, ref := OutcomeRef}} -> OutcomeRef;
 3043:                 _ ->
 3044:                     timer:sleep(50),
 3045:                     completed_remote_operation(
 3046:                       Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 3047:             end;
 3048:         _ ->
 3049:             timer:sleep(50),
 3050:             completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 3051:     end.
 3052: 
 3053: wait_operation_terminal(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 3054:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 3055: wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 3056:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 3057:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 3058:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 3059:                 {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 3060:                   when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted ->
 3061:                     {Claim, Outcome};
 3062:                 _ ->
 3063:                     timer:sleep(50),
 3064:                     wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 3065:             end;
 3066:         _ ->
 3067:             timer:sleep(50),
 3068:             wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 3069:     end.

 3071: wait_remote_operation(_Gateway, _SessionId, _RequestBytes, _Signature,
 3072:                       _ClientPeer, 0) ->
 3073:     ct:fail(remote_operation_outcome_timeout);
 3074: wait_remote_operation(Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 3075:                       ClientPeer, Remaining) ->
 3076:     Result = peer:call(
 3077:                Gateway, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 3078:                [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 10000),
 3079:     case Result of
 3080:         {ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, _}} -> Result;
 3081:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 3082:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 3083:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} ->
 3084:             timer:sleep(250),
 3085:             wait_remote_operation(
 3086:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 3087:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 3088:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 3089:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 3090:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} ->
 3091:             timer:sleep(250),
 3092:             wait_remote_operation(
 3093:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 3094:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 3095:         Other ->
 3096:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_invalid, Other})
 3097:     end.

 3106: run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, Wave) ->
 3107:     %% `run_scope_proofs/3` owns a 10-second completion window. The peer call
 3108:     %% must outlive it; its default five seconds can otherwise time out before
 3109:     %% the helper can report the actual wave result.
 3110:     Results = peer:call(
 3111:                 Asker, ?MODULE, run_scope_proofs,
 3112:                 [?ASKER_NS, Goal, ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE], 15000),
 3113:     case Results of
 3114:         List when is_list(List), length(List) =:= ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE ->
 3115:             lists:foreach(
 3116:               fun({ok, [_], _}) -> ok;
 3117:                  (Result) -> ct:fail({scope_proof_failed, Wave, Result})
 3118:               end, List);
 3119:         timeout -> ct:fail({scope_proof_timeout, Wave});
 3120:         Other -> ct:fail({scope_proof_wave_failed, Wave, Other})
 3121:     end.
 3122: 
 3123: run_scope_proofs(Ns, Goal, Count) ->
 3124:     Parent = self(),
 3125:     _ = [spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {proof_done, quod_prolog:prove(Ns, Goal)} end)
 3126:          || _ <- lists:seq(1, Count)],
 3127:     collect_scope_proofs(Count, []).
 3128: 
 3129: collect_scope_proofs(0, Results) -> lists:reverse(Results);
 3130: collect_scope_proofs(Count, Results) ->
 3131:     receive
 3132:         {proof_done, Result} -> collect_scope_proofs(Count - 1, [Result | Results])
 3133:     after 10000 ->
 3134:         timeout
 3135:     end.

 3148: open_client_session(Peer, NetworkId, NodeKey,
 3149:                     KeyPair = {PublicKey, _Seed}, ClientPeer) ->
 3150:     ClientNonce = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 3151:     {ok, Challenge} = peer:call(
 3152:                         Peer, quod_client_auth, issue_challenge,
 3153:                         [PublicKey, ClientNonce, ClientPeer]),
 3154:     ChallengeId = maps:get(challenge_id, Challenge),
 3155:     {ok, ChallengeBytes} = quod_client_auth:challenge_bytes(
 3156:                              NetworkId, NodeKey, ChallengeId, PublicKey,
 3157:                              ClientNonce, maps:get(server_nonce, Challenge),
 3158:                              maps:get(expires_ms, Challenge)),
 3159:     Signature = quod_identity:sign(
 3160:                   ChallengeBytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair)),
 3161:     {ok, Session} = peer:call(
 3162:                       Peer, quod_client_auth, complete_challenge,
 3163:                       [ChallengeId, Signature]),
 3164:     Session.

 3172: signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair,
 3173:                     AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 3174:                     SessionExpires, Mode, GoalText) ->
 3175:     Request = #{network_identity => NetworkId,
 3176:                 signing_public_key => PublicKey,
 3177:                 operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 3178:                 agent_namespace => AgentNamespace,
 3179:                 agent_genesis_anchor => AgentAnchor,
 3180:                 agent_instance_text => <<"human_user(test_agent).">>,
 3181:                 mode => Mode, parser_version => 1,
 3182:                 not_after_ms => min(
 3183:                                   SessionExpires,
 3184:                                   quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
 3185:                 goal_text => GoalText},
 3186:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(Request),
 3187:     {Bytes,

 3213: start_node(Name, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Ns, Genesis, Seeds,
 3214:            DirectoryAllowlist, Config) ->
 3215:     %% Peer nodes must load the beam being tested.  `code:get_path/0` also
 3216:     %% contains dependency and older build paths, so put this suite's exact
 3217:     %% Quod ebin first instead of relying on their incidental ordering.
 3218:     QuodEbin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
 3219:     PeerPaths = [QuodEbin | lists:delete(QuodEbin, code:get_path())],
 3220:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
 3221:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io,
 3222:                             args => ["-pa" | PeerPaths]}),
 3223:     %% These compiled inputs stay fixed for the peer's lifetime. Cache their
 3224:     %% directory listings instead of re-searching every path on each load.
 3225:     InstalledPaths = peer:call(Peer, code, get_path, []),
 3226:     true = peer:call(Peer, code, set_path, [InstalledPaths, cache]),
 3227:     lists:foreach(
 3228:       fun(Module) ->
 3229:           {module, Module} = peer:call(
 3230:                                Peer, code, ensure_loaded, [Module]),
 3231:           QuodEbin = filename:dirname(
 3232:                        peer:call(Peer, code, which, [Module]))
 3233:       end, [quod_simplex, quod_scope_session, quod_ask]),
 3234:     true = peer:call(
 3235:              Peer, erlang, function_exported,
 3236:              [quod_simplex, start_link, 2]),
 3237:     %% Runtime lifecycle preparation may legitimately use the application's
 3238:     %% default data root. Keep that root private to this peer and CT run: the
 3239:     %% VM-local unique_integer/1 sequence restarts in later runs, so sharing
 3240:     %% the developer cache could reopen an old genesis under a dead test key.
 3241:     CacheDir = filename:join(
 3242:                  ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3243:                  atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_cache"),
 3244:     true = peer:call(
 3245:              Peer, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", CacheDir]),
 3246:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
 3247:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
 3248:     Key = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
 3249:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
 3250:     Set(listen_port, Port),
 3251:     Set(node_addr, {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
 3252:     Set(node_pubkey, Pub),
 3253:     Set(identity_key, Key),
 3254:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
 3255:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir,
 3256:         filename:join(
 3257:           ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3258:           atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_effect_journal")),
 3259:     Set(foreign_log,
 3260:         #{cache_dir => filename:join(
 3261:                          ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3262:                          atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_foreign_log")}),
 3263:     %% These peers do not run the production directory-advertisement loop for
 3264:     %% every synthetic namespace. Keep their explicit certified route fixtures
 3265:     %% alive for the whole suite so long-running protocol cases test the route,
 3266:     %% not fixture expiry.
 3267:     _ = DirectoryAllowlist,
 3268:     Set(directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}),
 3269:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
 3270:     start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config),
 3271:     Peer.
 3272: 
 3273: start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config) ->
 3274:     DataDir = filename:join(
 3275:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3276:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 3277:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 3278:                    "_", Ns])),
 3279:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => create, role => member,
 3280:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds,
 3281:             genesis_file => Genesis},
 3282:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 3283:     ok.
 3284: 
 3285: start_join_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Anchor, Seeds, Config) ->
 3286:     DataDir = filename:join(
 3287:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3288:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 3289:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 3290:                    "_observer_", Ns])),
 3291:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => join, genesis_hash => Anchor,
 3292:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds},
 3293:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 3294:     ok.
 3295: 
 3296: start_root_namespace(Peer, Pub, Config) ->
 3297:     DataDir = filename:join(
 3298:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3299:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 3300:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 3301:                    "_", ?ROOT_NS])),
 3302:     Content = #{namespace => ?ROOT_NS, mode => create,
 3303:                 genesis_file => <<"ontologies/quod_root.pl">>,
 3304:                 data_dir => list_to_binary(DataDir), seeds => []},
 3305:     {?ROOT_NS, Cfg0} = peer:call(
 3306:                          Peer, quod_app, build_ns_config, [Content]),
 3307:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
 3308:                 Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
 3309:                 [?ROOT_NS, Cfg0#{node_id => Pub}]),
 3310:     ok.
 3311: 
 3312: start_brahms(Peer, Ns, SelfAddr, Seeds) ->
 3313:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_brahms, start_namespace,
 3314:                         [Ns, #{node_id => SelfAddr, seed_peers => Seeds}]),
 3315:     ok.
 3316: 
 3317: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal) ->
 3318:     wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, 750).
 3319: 
 3320: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, _Goal, 0) ->
 3321:     ct:fail(
 3322:       {ontology_never_ready, Ns,
 3323:        #{children => peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, children, []),
 3324:          desired => peer:call(
 3325:                       Peer, application, get_env,
 3326:                       [quod, namespace_desired, undefined]),
 3327:          genesis => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 3328:          status => peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]),
 3329:          prolog => peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns])}});
 3330: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries) ->
 3331:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 5000) of
 3332:         {error, rebuilding} ->
 3333:             timer:sleep(20),
 3334:             wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries - 1);
 3335:         {ok, _, _} -> ok;
 3336:         Other -> ct:fail({not_ready, Ns, Other})
 3337:     end.
 3338: 
 3339: wait_scope_workers(_Peer, _Expected, 0) -> ct:fail(scope_worker_timeout);
 3340: wait_scope_workers(Peer, Expected, Retries) ->
 3341:     wait_engine_stat(Peer, ?NS, scope_workers, Expected, Retries).
 3342: 
 3343: wait_engine_stat(_Peer, _Ns, _Key, _Expected, 0) ->
 3344:     ct:fail(engine_stat_timeout);
 3345: wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries) ->
 3346:     Stats = peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [Ns]),
 3347:     case maps:get(Key, Stats, undefined) of
 3348:         Expected -> ok;
 3349:         _ ->
 3350:             timer:sleep(10),
 3351:             wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries - 1)
 3352:     end.
 3353: 
 3354: key_before(TargetPub) ->
 3355:     {Pub, _} = Key = quod_identity:generate(),
 3356:     case Pub < TargetPub of
 3357:         true -> Key;
 3358:         false -> key_before(TargetPub)
 3359:     end.
 3360: 
 3361: deep_failure_rules() ->
 3362:     [[io_lib:format("deep_failure(~B) :- deep_failure(~B).~n", [N, N - 1])
 3363:       || N <- lists:seq(70, 1, -1)],
 3364:      "deep_failure(0) :- fail_with_reason(deep_bottom).\n",
 3365:      %% Build the nested reasons at proof time, so the test exercises the
 3366:      %% remote reply rather than a genesis literal.
 3367:      "deep_reason :- deep_reason_value(70, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3368:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3369:      "deep_reason_value(0, Acc, Acc).\n"
 3370:      "deep_reason_value(N, Acc, Out) :- N > 0, Next is N - 1, "
 3371:      "deep_reason_value(Next, [Acc], Out).\n"].
 3372: 
 3373: gui(Goal) -> {'::',<<"quod:gui">>,Goal}.
